jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Five88 & The Coronet)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

  

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Coordinate and oversee diversified programs, activities and special events for seniors, including bingo, arts and crafts, monthly birthday parties, and lite exercise programs, as space permits.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Bilingual English/Cantonese or English/Mandarin preferred
* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in:
* + after-school programs or educational settings for youth
  + social services working with seniors.
  + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self-starter, multi-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR & First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check

**The details:**

* **This is a full-time (40 hrs/wk), non-exempt position and provides services at two sites.**
* **Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9am-5:30pm**
* + **Five88 Apartments (Family Resource Center):** Monday/Wednesday/Friday
  + **The Coronet (Senior Resource Center):** Tuesday/Thursday
* **Location**:
* + Five88 Apartments, 588 Mission Bay Blvd North, San Francisco, CA 94158; and
  + The Coronet Apartments, 3595 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94118
* **Wage:** $30/hr
* **Benefits offered**:
* + Health insurance, dental insurance, term life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). Additionally, the following voluntary benefits are available at 100% employee cost: vision insurance, voluntary life insurance, pet insurance, and supplemental benefits.
  + Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match

jobs.title: TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Hamilton Families, our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 1985, we have been meeting the most urgent needs of unhoused families in our community. Our programs specialize in preventing family homelessness when possible, providing shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, supporting the wellbeing and academic achievement of children who experience homelessness, and quickly returning families to safe and stable housing throughout the Greater Bay Area. At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re excited to be adding a **Case Manager** toour team! This is an engaging and rewarding opportunity that plays an integral role within the organization. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with our participants and contributing to the fight against homelessness. The **Case Manager** will report directly to the Family Services Manager and be part of the Shelter Program team. This position provides case management to families in the shelter program using various service models. This involves documenting services in real-time, maintaining electronic case records, and collecting monthly compliance reports.

**What Your Day Looks Like**

* Offer personalized case management to participants, guiding them through intake, assessments, and tailored service plans that meet their unique needs

* Welcome families during intake and orientation, collaborating to create actionable plans that address housing, recovery, and children’s needs
* Build strong networks with community services to ensure participants receive the support they deserve
* Work closely with case managers, supervisors, and community partners to provide seamless and effective support for families
* Uphold program policies while keeping clear and accurate records of participant progress and experiences
* Prepare and submit insightful reports that highlight the impact of services and track our program's success
* Actively participate in team meetings, training sessions, and community events to strengthen our mission
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and organizational policies, and attend hearings as needed
* Encourage participant involvement in decision-making and program activities, fostering a sense of ownership
* Take on additional responsibilities as requested to support our mission

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

* Ability to work and collaborate with a diverse group of people on projects and making decisions for the benefit of our participants
* Familiarity with case management databases or customer service platforms
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet goals
* Demonstrated ability to exercise appropriate judgement and uphold policies and procedures
* Skilled in documentation, reporting, and maintaining confidentiality

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in social work, psychology, human services setting or related field
* A background in working with nonprofit organizations, social services organizations, or community-based programs
* Familiarity with Bay Area resources for low-income families
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and other software
* Ability to travel locally and long distance to meet with vendors and participants

**Why Choose Us**

* Our commitment to welcome all individuals creates a richness of viewpoints and keen ability to challenge established thinking

* Employer matched 403(b) retirement plan

* Resourceful

**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Sales & Service Overnights, Sales & Service Associates, and Kids' Club Attendants (at clubs with a Kids' Club), and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club (where applicable), club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. jobs.description:
One Hat One Hand is a design and fabrication company specializing in architectural placemaking, large-scale public art, product prototyping and experiential design.

Our team of designers, fabricators, artists, welders & technologists work with artisans and builders to create large-scale placemaking features, art fabrication and specialty installations. We collaborate with our clients every step of the way, taking pride in the talents and creative skills of our team. We work hard to produce seemingly impossible installations through thoughtful design, hands-on fabrication, and technology integration.

Our website offers a deeper dive into our world, our work, our people and our process. Please visit us at www.onehatonehand.com

**PROJECT MANAGER | ONE HAT ONE HAND**

One Hat One Hand is seeking a qualified Project Manager with experience in interior design, architecture, event production, industrial design, custom fabrication, and/or construction. The role is primarily a project management position but also requires a strong design sensibility, the ability to design and 3D model in Rhino, and the ability to read and redline architectural drawing sets. The right candidate is detail-oriented, excited by teamwork, and has a background in project management and design for fabrication.

**Overview**

The Project Manager is responsible for successfully overseeing and delivering all contracted scope for a given project, incorporating aspects of account management, production management, project management, and design. This role ensures clear communication of the project schedule and deliverables among clients, designers, and the production team.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Primary contact for Clients, Consultants, Account Managers, and Project Stakeholders.
* Oversee the development of design concepts, 3D visualizations, and presentation decks for client meetings
* Collaborate with designers and the internal Production Department for prototyping strategies, build drawings, production schedules, and install and maintenance plans
* Manage the production of technical documentation for coordination with contractors, structural engineering, MEP engineering, and permitting
* Coordinate and conduct meetings with project stakeholders; create agendas, take detailed notes, and distribute follow-up materials
* Maintain communication regarding scope, schedule, and budget with all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with subcontractors and client on problem solving, documenting changes, and foreseeing change orders or scope creep with account managers
* Project based time management of hours allocated per task, phase, and department
* Coordinate fabrication schedules within and between projects
* Track and manage project finances; issue contracts, budget revisions, and invoices; source, order materials, and coordinate deliveries
* Prepare and present intermediate and final job reports
* Compile final documentation of project (photos, designs, descriptions) in collaboration with the marketing department
* Work with Design Studio Manager to ensure project asset are being organized and archived for easy cross department navigation
* Create and maintain tools to facilitate cross functional collaboration
* Collaborating with account managers and finance on creating, maintaining, and tracking internal and external budgets
* Ensuring that projects are created with reasonable and profitable budgets.
* Performing Regular 360 project reviews to ensure, budget is reflective of materials, labor, and design. That assets are organized, and departments are aware of the project timeline
* Find opportunities to add value to clients and exceed client expectations to ensure client retention and satisfaction for future projects

  

**Essential Skills and Experience**

* Project management, client management, schedule creation and management, and construction administration
* Highly creative with strong critical thinking skills
* Passion for experiential storytelling and inclusive team management
* Clear and concise written and spoken communication skills
* Detail-oriented with professional meeting etiquette and management skills; agenda creation, concise note taking, and punctuality
* Knowledge of materials, fabrication techniques and technologies, and rapid prototyping including CNC, laser cutting, waterjet, 3D printing
* Knowledge of production, construction, engineering, and architectural terminology
* Highly adaptable in transferring skills and knowledge to new jobs that may require flexibility in systems previously developed or used
* Strong design sensibility, storyboarding, presentation design, graphic design, sketching, drawing markup
* 3D modeling, rendering. MUST be able to use RHINO and be able to design at a mid level.
* Programs: Adobe CS, Bluebeam, Asana, Instagantt or other Gantt charts, GSuite, Procore, Rhino

  

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000 per year, depending on experience. This role is hybrid but the ability to attend meetings at our campus headquarters and client job sites as needed is required.

jobs.description:
**About DCL Logistics**

For over 40 years, DCL Logistics has powered the brands that shape how the world shops. We are a modern 3PL and a technology company at heart, trusted by high-growth, innovative names in consumer electronics, health and beauty, wellness, and connected devices. Our proprietary platforms (eFactory, SelectShip, and ReturnTrak) give our clients full command of their supply chain, and our ISO 9001:2015 certified facilities deliver the precision and quality their customers expect. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with a national network reaching 96% of the U.S. population on two-day ground, we help ambitious brands scale without limits.

**Why DCL**

We are more than a fulfillment company. We are a team of people who make it happen. Our culture is built on four core values that show up in everything we do: Make It Happen, Be Resourceful, Deliver Operational Excellence, and We Care. Here, your work is visible, your ideas matter, and your impact is real from day one. We move fast, we hold ourselves to the highest standard, and we take care of our people. When you join DCL, you don't just join an organization. You join a family.

**Location Requirements:**

This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Perris, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**About the Role**

The Project Manager (PM) will lead internal initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and performance across our fulfillment network. This role is focused on both **operational execution** and **IT project delivery**—driving cross-functional initiatives, implementing systems, and standardizing processes that support our warehouse operations and technology platforms. The Project Manager will partner with stakeholders across operations, IT, engineering, customer service and leadership to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact.

This role reports directly to the Company President.

**Responsibilities**

* Plan and manage cross-functional projects end-to-end: scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.
* Serve as the central point of coordination between IT, Operations, Accounting, and other functional teams, translating each group's priorities and constraints into a shared project plan.
* Run regular status meetings, steering committee updates, and stakeholder check-ins; maintain clear, consistent project documentation (charters, RAID logs, status reports).
* Identify and resolve cross-departmental bottlenecks, conflicting priorities, and resource contention before they become blockers.
* Establish and improve lightweight project management standards, templates, and governance so future cross-functional work doesn't have to start from scratch.
* Track project health (scope, schedule, budget, risk) and escalate proactively when a project is at risk.
* Partner with functional managers to ensure resources are allocated appropriately without disrupting day-to-day departmental operations.
* Support post-project reviews and capture lessons learned to continuously improve delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* **PMP Certified with 3–6 years o**f project management experience in logistics, fulfillment, supply chain, or IT project delivery.
* Strong understanding of fulfillment and warehouse operations, as well as related technology systems.
* Experience leading IT projects involving WMS, OMS, ERP, or ecommerce integrations.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Proficiency in project management tools (Asana, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent).
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or ITIL certification a plus.

jobs.description:
**AV Project Manager**
----------------------

CTI has been a leading audiovisual provider since we began in 1988, and from the beginning our mission has been simple: to provide a fantastic customer experience.  
  
At CTI, our biggest asset is our people, and we know that sometimes the most awesome employees don’t fit the typical mold. If you are hardworking, friendly, and know the importance of fantastic customer service, you could be a good fit at CTI. We have developed a collaborative and lively working environment, where the best and the brightest show up to work each day ready to have fun and employ their passion for and knowledge of technology in everything they do. This creative atmosphere helps us apply and share our skills with our clients, who seek quality, high-end AV and Conference Solutions.

**What are we looking for?**

Are you a passionate AV enthusiast with a knack for project management? We're looking for an experienced AV Project Manager who embodies our mission: “to provide a fantastic customer experience.” We need a dynamic, highly organized self-starter who isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves and get the job done on time. You'll handle all aspects of AV integration projects, excel at delegating responsibilities, and possess top-notch communication skills.

**What are your Responsibilities?**

* Strategize Like a Pro: Develop and implement strategies to achieve project goals, like a master chess player plotting the ultimate checkmate. Your moves will ensure seamless AV integration.
* Resource Ringmaster: Schedule all necessary corporate services and labor resources, including programming, touch panel wizardry, rack build magic, installation, and commissioning. Think of yourself as the conductor of an AV symphony.
* Deadline Dynamo: Communicate project deadlines, specifications, and budgets to the AV install team with the precision of a Swiss watch. Your timing will keep everything in sync.
* Document Detective: Ensure all project documents are current and accurate, from detailed drawings to comprehensive bills of materials and change orders. Sherlock Holmes has nothing on you.
* Client Confidant: Maintain a steady stream of communication with clients, providing them with timely updates on issues, scope changes, schedules, and project progress. You'll be their go-to guru.
* Team Captain: Lead and inspire a team of talented employees, overseeing training and performance management. Think of yourself as the coach of an all-star AV team.
* Delegation Dynamo: Delegate responsibilities with the precision of a maestro, ensuring that team members are identified, documented, and current. No task too small, no detail overlooked.
* AV Superhero: Support the AV install staff in bringing projects to life, from installation and programming to final punch lists. Your cape is optional, but your expertise is essential.
* Deadline Defender: Ensure projects stay on track to meet client deadlines and that the current margin accurately reflects the remaining work. You'll be the guardian of the timeline.

**Does experience count?**

Of course! But we take into account your experience and the skills you bring to the table.

* An Associate's degree is preferred, but not required.
* Project Planning and Managing: 5+ years managing commercial AV integration projects, developing strategies, and coordinating resources, **required.**
* Communication and Documentation: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proficiency in maintaining accurate project documents and client updates, **required.**
* Team Management: Experience in leading teams, including training and performance management, **required.**
* Technical Oversight: Hands-on experience with AV installations and providing creative solutions, **required.**
* Budget and Performance Monitoring: Ability to track and improve performance metrics, ensuring projects meet deadlines and budget goals, **required.**
* Travel: Meet the clients where they are and provide guidance to the technical staff on site. (Company paid, overnight travel estimated around 25%)

**What’s in it for you?**

At CTI, we know our company’s success is directly correlated to the success of our employees. So, it’s fitting that we thrive on and encourage employee growth, both professionally and personally. Our competitive compensation package includes:

A culture where “fun is mandatory”, teams value your ideas, we celebrate wins (big and small), and you have support. As well as opportunities for growth and learning.

* Competitive Base Salary
* Employer-matched medical, prescription, and dental insurance (available after 60 days of employment)
* Employer matched 401K up to 3% (after 6 months of employment)
* Bonus eligibility that is based off our results-oriented incentive plan (after 3 months of employment)
* A graduated PTO program, all major holidays off, as well as three “floating” holidays, available upon your first day of employment
* Special gifts for significant life events, such as marriage, the birth of a child, and buying a house
* Cell phone reimbursement plan
* Long- and Short-Term Disability 100% paid by CTI
* Life Insurance 100% paid by CTI

*CTI. is an equal opportunity employer. We do not and shall not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status in any of its activities or operations. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.*

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Stratus**

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public- and private-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

  

**The Role**

Stratus® has recently partnered with E.A. Bonelli, and we're hiring a Design Technician for our Structural engineering group. This role is responsible for creating, managing, and coordinating complex structural design models and construction documentation for building and infrastructure projects. This role leads our structural BIM/CAD efforts, ensures alignment with engineering calculations and design intent, and supports multi-disciplinary coordination. The position requires independent execution of advanced modeling tasks, close collaboration with structural engineers, and mentorship of junior designers to deliver high-quality, code-compliant structural documents.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop detailed structural 2D and 3D CAD/BIM models (g.Framing plans, foundation plans, sections, details, connection layouts) aligned with engineering calculations and specifications.
* Lead multi-disciplinary coordination, ensuring structural systems integrate with architectural, MEP and civil models without clashes.
* Perform and oversee control reviews of structural drawings and models, verifying accuracy, constructability, and compliance with applicable building codes and project standards.
* Collaborate closely with structural engineers to translate design criteria, load paths, and calculations into accurate constructible documents.
* Mentor junior designers on structural drafting standards, detailing best practices, and BIM/CAD workflows.
* Generate and manage structural construction documents, including general notes, schedules (steel, rebar, concrete), and detailed sections.
* Support development of shop drawing reviews, RFIs and design revisions by incorporating engineering changes into BIM/CAD models and plan sets.
* Establish and maintain structural BIM standards, including model organization, naming conventions, and level of development (LOD).
* Assist in analysis, coordination, troubleshooting and resolving complex software issues, conducting advanced modeling tasks, and identifying process improvements for BIM/CAD workflows.
* Prepare 3D visualizations and coordination views for constructability reviews and client presentations.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate’s degree or certification in CAD, BIM, Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
* 2 - 6 years of experience in CAD/BIM design within building and infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience producing structural construction documents and coordinating with engineering teams.

**Why you’ll love Stratus**

* A team-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success
* Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize
* Learning & Development – Education and Professional Licensing
* We believe flexible, hybrid work supports the balance and well-being our team deserves
* Excellent Health Care Programs – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* Company-paid Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
* Voluntary Life Insurance options for employees, spouses, and dependents
* 401k Retirement Plan with employer match
* Paid Holidays & Competitive PTO plans

Interested in learning more about Stratus, please visit https://www.stratusteam.com/ .

Stratus® is an integrated, multi-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public- and private-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places.

  

**The Role**

Stratus® has recently partnered with E.A. Bonelli, and we're hiring a Design Technician for our Structural engineering group. This role is responsible for creating, managing, and coordinating complex structural design models and construction documentation for building and infrastructure projects. This role leads our structural BIM/CAD efforts, ensures alignment with engineering calculations and design intent, and supports multi-disciplinary coordination. The position requires independent execution of advanced modeling tasks, close collaboration with structural engineers, and mentorship of junior designers to deliver high-quality, code-compliant structural documents.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop detailed structural 2D and 3D CAD/BIM models (g.Framing plans, foundation plans, sections, details, connection layouts) aligned with engineering calculations and specifications.
* Lead multi-disciplinary coordination, ensuring structural systems integrate with architectural, MEP and civil models without clashes.
* Perform and oversee control reviews of structural drawings and models, verifying accuracy, constructability, and compliance with applicable building codes and project standards.
* Collaborate closely with structural engineers to translate design criteria, load paths, and calculations into accurate constructible documents.
* Mentor junior designers on structural drafting standards, detailing best practices, and BIM/CAD workflows.
* Generate and manage structural construction documents, including general notes, schedules (steel, rebar, concrete), and detailed sections.
* Support development of shop drawing reviews, RFIs and design revisions by incorporating engineering changes into BIM/CAD models and plan sets.
* Establish and maintain structural BIM standards, including model organization, naming conventions, and level of development (LOD).
* Assist in analysis, coordination, troubleshooting and resolving complex software issues, conducting advanced modeling tasks, and identifying process improvements for BIM/CAD workflows.
* Prepare 3D visualizations and coordination views for constructability reviews and client presentations.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* Associate’s degree or certification in CAD, BIM, Architecture, Engineering, or related field.
* 2 - 6 years of experience in CAD/BIM design within building and infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated experience producing structural construction documents and coordinating with engineering teams.

The **County of San Mateo’s Technology Services Department** **(TSD)** seeks a **Radio Systems** **IS Project Manager I** to support Radio Services and assigned initiatives within the Network Service Division (NSD). This position combines project management with customer relationship management and administration of the agreements, vendor contracts, and licenses that support these services.

The primary responsibilities include managing assigned Radio Services and NSD projects; serving as a liaison to public safety partners, County departments, and other customers; coordinating Radio Services memoranda of understanding (MOUs) and lease agreements; administering assigned vendor contracts and licenses; translating Radio Services MOU deliverables into trackable customer billing routines; and maintaining project information in the department’s Planview project management suite.

Under general supervision, the incumbent plans, coordinates, and manages department-specific technology projects throughout their life cycle, including identifying customer needs, gathering requirements, evaluating feasibility, defining scope and budgets, developing schedules, coordinating technical reviews and testing, and overseeing implementation and close-out. Assignments include small projects and medium-sized projects whose scope, risk, and budget are appropriate to the IS Project Manager I classification. Projects may include radio equipment upgrades, microwave infrastructure, radio site improvements, network equipment replacements, connectivity upgrades, and related technology or business process improvements.

The incumbent receives general supervision from assigned supervisory or management personnel and may provide technical and functional direction and training to staff on a project basis. The position works closely with Radio Services and NSD technical specialists, County departments, partner agencies, customers, and vendors to coordinate resources, manage dependencies, track deliverables, address implementation risks, and resolve issues.

  

The **ideal candidate** for this position will:

* Have 2–3 years of project management experience with information technology, network, or communications infrastructure projects, including requirements gathering, scheduling, budgeting, risk management, and implementation.
* Have 2–3 years of experience building and maintaining effective working relationships with public safety agencies and partners. Work effectively with network and radio technical specialists, County departments, customers, and vendors, and communicate clearly with both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Have experience administering contracts, service agreements, MOUs, or leases, including tracking obligations, amendments, renewals, and vendor performance.
* Have experience coordinating technology upgrades and service transitions, including implementation schedules, testing, customer communications, and operational handoff.
* Use Planview or a comparable project management system to maintain accurate schedules, budgets, milestones, resource information, and status reports across multiple assigned projects.
* Understand the operational needs of public safety communications. Experience with land mobile radio, microwave systems, or related infrastructure is desirable.
* Organize multiple assignments, document decisions, address competing priorities, and escalate issues requiring management approval.

QUALITY MANAGER Custom Plastic Injection Molding | Medical Manufacturing

**Location: Livermore, California**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Quality Manager** to lead and maintain our ISO 13485 Quality Management System in a growing, fast-paced custom plastic injection molding manufacturing environment.

Reporting directly to the President, the Quality Manager will oversee quality systems, compliance, inspection and testing, customer and supplier quality, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. This individual will lead and develop a three-shift quality team while ensuring products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and established quality standards.

The ideal candidate has direct experience managing an ISO 13485-certified Quality Management System and a deep understanding of FDA requirements—and understands how to build a culture of accountability, risk-based decision-making, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead the maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's ISO 13485 Quality Management System.
* Maintain the documented quality system, including procedures, records, document control, training, and change management.
* Oversee Management Reviews, quality objectives, performance metrics, and QMS effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate quality-system controls are established for risk management, process validation, and production activities.
* Maintain awareness of applicable FDA requirements and other relevant regulatory and customer requirements.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee nonconformance reporting (NCR), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause investigations, and effectiveness verification.
* Analyze customer complaints, nonconformance trends, scrap, rework, and other quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate structured problem-solving and preventive action initiatives.
* Monitor corrective actions and ensure timely, effective resolution.

**Audits & Customer/Supplier Quality**

* Plan, coordinate, and host customer, registrar, and other applicable quality audits.

* Manage customer complaints and corrective action responses, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete communication.
* Oversee supplier quality performance, monitoring, corrective actions, and periodic reevaluation in coordination with Purchasing.
* Work directly with customers and suppliers to resolve quality issues and negotiate appropriate corrective actions.

* Manage inspection, testing, measurement, and product acceptance activities.
* Ensure measuring and monitoring equipment is appropriately controlled, calibrated, and maintained.
* Oversee the use of CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and other inspection equipment.
* Apply statistical process control and capability analysis, including Cpk and Gauge R&R, as appropriate.
* Support engineering changes (ECOs), controlled process deviations, and related quality records.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop the three-shift quality team, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and performance standards.

* Minimum of **5 years of quality operations experience** in a production or manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing an **ISO 13485 Quality Management System**, including responsibility for QMS effectiveness, audits, CAPA, nonconformances, and Management Reviews.
* Strong working knowledge of root cause analysis, risk management, corrective action, and preventive action.
* Experience managing internal and external audits and responding to customer quality requirements.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, procedures, specifications, and regulatory documentation.
* Experience with inspection and measurement tools, including CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and related equipment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated leadership, employee training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively to a team.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

* Familiarity with applicable FDA quality requirements and customer-specific regulatory expectations.

jobs.title: RCM Operations Specialist, Infusion (AI Platform)
jobs.description:
**About Trellis**  
Trellis builds AI that handles intake, benefits, prior authorization and reimbursement for infusion and specialty pharmacy providers, so patients start therapy faster and providers get paid for it.

**The role**  
You will be our expert on infusion prior authorization and reimbursement. Our system reads referrals, clinical notes and payer policies, then prepares the work that intake and reimbursement teams do by hand today. Your job is to make sure that work is right. You will review real cases across our customers, catch what the system gets wrong and explain why. Then you turn that judgment into rules and test cases our engineers build on. You will work directly with the product and engineering team.

**What you will do**

* Review prior authorization and reimbursement cases for infusion customers, covering benefits, coverage, PA requirements, medical necessity, billing codes and units
* Check each decision against payer policies, Medicare LCDs and NCDs, payer portals and the patient's clinical documentation
* Build answer keys that record the correct outcome for real cases, with the reasoning and source behind each call
* Find patterns in errors and write them up clearly for product and engineering, with examples
* Keep a working library of payer rules, drug coverage criteria and billing conventions up to date
* Learn how customer intake and reimbursement staff handle edge cases, and bring those conventions into the product
* Review early output during customer onboarding and flag risk before it reaches a claim

**What you bring**

* 3+ years in infusion or specialty pharmacy revenue cycle, such as prior authorization, benefits verification, billing, denials or appeals
* Working knowledge of medical versus pharmacy benefit, buy and bill, HCPCS J codes, administration CPT codes, NDC to billing unit conversion and modifiers
* Comfort reading LCDs, NCDs and commercial medical policies and applying them to a specific patient
* Experience with payer portals and PA tools such as Availity or CoverMyMeds, and pharmacy or infusion systems such as CPR+ or WellSky
* Careful judgment. You know the difference between what the chart says and what someone assumed
* Clear writing. You can explain a denial risk in two sentences to someone who has never billed a claim

**Nice to have**

* A CPC, CPB, CRCS or similar certification, or a pharmacy technician or nursing background
* Experience at a home infusion provider, ambulatory infusion center or specialty pharmacy
* Experience with biologics, IVIG and other high cost therapies across Medicare, Medicaid and commercial plans
* Curiosity about how AI can change healthcare operations. No coding required

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* **Intro call with Ahmed (30 min).** Your background, the kind of reimbursement work you have done, and what you want next.
* **Case review exercise (60 to 90 min).** We share two or three anonymized infusion referrals with the relevant payer policy. You decide whether a PA is needed, whether the case meets coverage criteria, and how it should be billed. Then we go through your reasoning together. We care more about how you think and where you look than about a perfect answer.
* **Team conversations (45 min).** Meet the people on product and engineering you will work with every day, and ask anything about how we build.
* **References and offer.** We move quickly and will tell you where you stand after each step.

Compensation Range: $70K - $120K

Are you dedicated to empowering and supporting youth, regardless of their background? We're searching for passionate individuals to make a positive impact on the lives of foster youth. Become an integral part of their transformative journey and join the First Place for Youth team.

About First Place for Youth, We’re a leading non-profit organization dedicated to supporting foster youth in their transition to adulthood, with a focus on education, employment, and housing. We believe that all young people deserve the opportunity to thrive and lead successful, independent lives. Our comprehensive programs empower foster youth to overcome the unique challenges they face and build the skills, confidence, and connections they need to succeed.

**Why Work at First Place For Youth****:**

* **Meaningful Impact**: Help to transform the lives of foster youth on the cusp of adulthood. Your role will support them in their journey to conquer challenges, achieve independence, and fulfill their aspirations.
* **Innovative Approach:** We thrive on innovation, pushing the boundaries of foster care support. Your voice here matters, and you’ll contribute to programs that redefine the futures of these young lives.
* **Collaborative and Supportive Environment:** Embrace a dynamic and supportive workplace, where every team member is valued. Together, we're a force dedicated to uplifting youth. Expect professional growth, fueled by teamwork and collaboration.
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** We value the well-being of our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package. From health and wellness benefits to retirement plans, we ensure that our team members are taken care of so they can focus on their important work supporting foster youth.
* **Culture of Diversity and Inclusion:** We celebrate diversity in every form. At First Place for Youth, inclusivity reigns, creating a workplace where all voices are heard, respected, and empowered.

The ideal candidate is a program expert who is comfortable engaging externally, adapts to changing needs, and upholds fidelity to First Place's mission and model.

jobs.title: Sr. Business Analyst - Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio (USA) with Engineering Centers in Pune, India and Yokohama, Japan, Goken is a global Engineering Services and Product Development company founded in 2004. We partner with OEMs and suppliers across the mobility space, as well as clients in non-mobility industries, to deliver innovative solutions and accelerate product development.

At Goken, we embrace our motto of "Time to Innovate" by pushing boundaries, cultivating entrepreneurial thinking, and empowering individuals who thrive on tackling challenges, embrace fresh ideas, and are driven to create solutions that shape the future. This mindset fuels our mission and empowers our teams to solve complex problems, deliver measurable value, and move our clients and industries forward.

Our Vision is to empower associates to drive innovation and lead meaningful change wherever it's needed, ensuring we stay ahead of the challenges and opportunities of tomorrow. Our Mission is to build trust that fosters greatness in our people, excellence in our clients, and positive impact in the communities we serve.

Goken offers a competitive compensation structure and benefits that support professional growth and personal well-being. We also foster a culture built on high performance, collaboration, continuous improvement, and ongoing professional development.

**Summary:**

As a Senior Business Analyst, you will provide the analysis that underpins the strategic planning cycle for automotive vehicle development, build the models that frame strategic choices, and prepare the materials leadership uses to make decisions. The team you will join manages the planning, cost, resourcing, and reporting work that keeps a large engineering organization aligned on what it is building, when, and at what cost. This role suits someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex work and is comfortable partnering with senior leaders.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support the annual and quarterly strategic planning cycle for vehicle development by building planning models, defining objectives and KPIs with engineering directors, and tracking them throughout the year.
* Build business cases for cross-functional strategic initiatives, such as organizational changes, new site or capability launches, and cost-reduction programs, by sizing costs, benefits, and risks and tracking results after launch.
* Prepare executive-ready presentations, briefs, and pre-reads for leadership reviews, change boards, and company planning forums, then turn the discussion into documented decisions and action items.
* Build and maintain the dashboards and status reports used in vehicle development leadership meetings, and track follow-up on commitments.
* Build financial, headcount, and scenario models from organizational and program data to frame strategic options and recommendations, in partnership with Cost Engineering, Finance, and Resource Planning.
* Identify gaps in how plans are set, tracked, and reported, and design simple, repeatable processes and templates that the wider organization can adopt.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field (or equivalent experience), with at least 5 years of experience in corporate strategy, business or financial analysis, management consulting, or business operations.
* Experience building financial, headcount, or scenario models and translating results into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Experience supporting planning and goal-setting processes, such as KPIs, annual operating plans, or quarterly business reviews.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to build concise presentations and documents for executive audiences.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and work with large data sets in spreadsheets, SQL, or business intelligence tools.

Goken is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive, and engaging workplace across all global locations. We value diversity and provide equal opportunities for career growth and professional development, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Events & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Zilliz is a fast-growing startup developing the industry’s leading vector database for enterprise-grade AI. Founded by the engineers behind Milvus, the world’s most popular open-source vector database, the company builds next-generation database technologies to help organizations quickly create AI applications. On a mission to democratize AI, Zilliz is committed to simplifying data management for AI applications and making vector databases accessible to every organization.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Events & Operations Specialist to help plan and execute Zilliz's marketing and community events, while also supporting selected internal operations.

You'll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Developer Relations teams to coordinate everything from developer meetups and customer events to industry conferences and trade shows. This is a hands-on role that involves working with both internal teams and external partners to keep projects organized and events running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who's organized, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should enjoy working with different people, solving problems as they come up, and finding ways to improve how things get done. Events will be your primary focus, with a smaller portion of the role dedicated to internal operational and administrative support.

### **What You'll Do**

**Events & Marketing Support**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of developer meetups, community gatherings, sales events, conferences, and trade shows, primarily across North America and Europe.
* Manage event logistics, including registration, attendee communications, venue arrangements, vendors, materials, and on-site coordination.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, and DevRel teams to understand event objectives, coordinate resources, and ensure activities are delivered on schedule.
* Maintain event timelines, budgets, and task lists, follow up with stakeholders, and address issues that could affect execution.
* Coordinate with external vendors, venues, speakers, and partners throughout the event planning process.
* Contribute ideas to improve event formats, attendee engagement, and the overall event experience.
* Support post-event activities, including attendee follow-ups, lead coordination, feedback collection, and basic performance reporting.

**Internal Operations & Administrative Support**

* Assist with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate internal meetings, team activities, and other operational needs as they arise.
* Support improvements to internal processes and team coordination where needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in event marketing, event coordination, operations, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience organizing events or managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments.
* A proactive approach to work, with the ability to identify problems, take initiative, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience coordinating across internal teams and working with external vendors or partners.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities can change and processes may not always be clearly defined.
* A practical, resourceful approach to problem-solving, along with the willingness to contribute new ideas and take on different types of work.
* Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally to support events.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with developer meetups, technical community events, or B2B technology conferences.
* Familiarity with developer communities, open-source technologies, AI, or data infrastructure.
* Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.
* Familiarity with event management, project management, or marketing tools.

Zilliz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Marketing & Sales Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**\*\*Swayable is in office 3x a week out of our offices in Williamsburg, Brooklyn and San Francisco, CA**  
  
Swayable is a fast-growing AI and automated data science platform that measures public opinion, and the impact of messages and advertising content on it. We are a 50-person team backed by top technology and social impact investors, including Y Combinator. Founded in 2018 by physics PhDs, it is led by the former Executive Director for Digital Strategy at the New York Times. Clients include major consumer-facing brands (JP Morgan Chase, Airbnb, Paramount Pictures), technology companies (Anthropic, Meta, Amazon), academic researchers (MIT, Yale, Stanford) and mission-aligned civic advocacy campaigns (e.g. on climate, human rights and elections). Check our our values & culture deck to learn more: https://tinyurl.com/4zjchwzs

Joining Swayable means being on a team whose work changes the course of history. The technology we develop is at the leading edge of transforming some of the world's most important campaign organizations and enterprises: combatting disinformation, protecting democracy, and supporting the sustainable growth of consumer-facing brands.

**About The Role:**

Swayable is hiring a **Product Marketing & Sales Enablement Manager** to sit at the crossroads of product, engineering, and go-to-market, translating what's being built into what sellers say. You'll own the sales enablement materials, launch cadence, and onboarding curriculum that keep our GTM team aligned with the roadmap, while staying close enough to the field to know what's actually resonating with prospects and clients.

**What You'll Do:**

* Work with engineers, PMs, and Sales to understand the roadmap, translating innovations into reusable sales enablement materials
* Own launch rhythm — a repeatable cadence for major features and smaller updates
* Own Sales Enablement materials: decks, one-pagers, case studies, objection handling
* Work with Marketing to ensure brand and positioning strategy translates cleanly at the sales level
* Design and run Sales University end-to-end — the full onboarding/certification curriculum
* Own the standard demo narrative and environment, the default story every rep uses
* Sit in on qualification calls to capture what's resonating and what objections come up, then flag upsell/expansion signals to CS post-sale and track post-sale success against what was promised pre-sale
* Build the reusable pilot-to-program playbook template and conversion criteria framework

**Who You Are:**

* 4-6 years of product marketing and enablement experience, with experience in B2B SaaS
* Passion for building frameworks, processes, and strategy from scratch
* Excellent written communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity
* Are equally comfortable writing a launch announcement, building a competitive teardown, or running a cross-functional sync
* Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don't wait for someone else to define the playbook
* Proven ability to partner directly with engineers and product managers, turning technical concepts into simple, powerful stories
* Strong project management skills, you can juggle multiple launches and keep teams aligned under pressure
* Experience with sales enablement and competitive positioning for technical audiences
* Sharp writing and storytelling instincts, you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.

**Benefits**:

* 100% Medical, Dental & Vision Plans - no employee contribution required
* Generous PTO
* Equity Options
* 401k plan, FSA
* Ongoing professional development investments
* Salary: $120-150K, dependent on experience

Swayable is an equal opportunity employer. We strive to promote an organizational environment that values diversity and fosters growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other basis prohibited by law. The team especially encourages applicants from underrepresented backgrounds.

jobs.title: Employment Support Lead (Job Coach)
jobs.description:
Since January 6, 1964, Futures has been dedicated to enriching the lives of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. What began with a small group of young adults, their families, and founding Director Helen Young in Lafayette, California, has grown into an organization serving individuals across multiple California counties.

We are seeking a compassionate, motivated, and collaborative **Employment Support Lead (Job Coach)** to support individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities in achieving their employment, community integration, and independent living goals. **As an Employment Support Lead, you will work closely with the Program Coordinator and Employment Support Supervisor.**

This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for providing direct participant support while mentoring, training, and guiding our participants and Employment Support Professional staff. The ideal candidate is a positive role model who leads by example, communicates effectively, embraces new approaches, and is committed to helping both participants and team members succeed.

**As the Employment Support Lead, you will maintain a caseload of participants who you will support in reaching their goals. * Assist participants in exploring vocational interests, identifying strengths, and discovering meaningful employment opportunities.

* Develop and implement strategies, tools, and techniques to improve job skills, workplace performance, and independence.
* Provide on-the-job coaching, workplace integration support, and job retention services.
* Promote self-advocacy, communication, social skills, and positive workplace behaviors.
* Encourage participants to build confidence, develop new skills, and work toward greater independence.

* Support participants in developing independent living, money management, communication, mobility, travel training, and community integration skills.
* Assist with activities related to health and safety, personal care, recreation, education, cultural events, and social development.
* Promote participant choice, dignity, independence, and meaningful community involvement.
* Advocate for participants' rights and support their involvement in self-advocacy and personal decision-making.

* Prepare and review ISP/IHSP summaries and monthly planning documents.
* Attend annual and semi-annual meetings and communicate progress toward participant goals.
* Distribute annual satisfaction surveys and maintain updated participant information and goal documentation.

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is a natural mentor who is dependable, adaptable, organized, and committed to helping others reach their full potential.

You should be someone who:

* Is open to learning new methodologies and improving existing practices.

jobs.title: Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Global Network BMCC Committee Program Manager provides hands-on project management, coordination and operational support for the BMCC committee and related network priorities. Working with leaders and colleagues across US and Group member firms, this role helps translate committee direction into organized workplans, well-prepared meetings, clear action items and timely follow-through. The role also provides production support for select communications, business development, events and shared resources connected to committee priorities. The ideal candidate is an early-to-mid-career professional who communicates clearly, manages details well and is comfortable coordinating multiple workstreams in a collaborative global environment.

**What You Will Do:**

* Maintain annual committee calendars, forward agendas and workplans; coordinate recurring meetings and working sessions; and help ensure priorities, milestones and dependencies are visible and actively managed.
* Build agendas, briefing materials, presentations and meeting decks; coordinate inputs, version control and final review; document decisions and action items; and follow up with owners to support timely completion.
* Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, status reports, decision logs, action trackers and shared files for committee-sponsored initiatives; identify risks, gaps and dependencies; and escalate issues when needed.
* Serve as a central point of coordination across committee members, workstream leads and BMCC colleagues across the US and Group; schedule working sessions, gather inputs and keep stakeholders informed of progress, decisions and upcoming deadlines.
* Assist with building, organizing and maintaining a central library of tender materials, credentials, case studies and reusable content; help ensure materials are current, clearly labelled and easy to find.
* Track agreed priorities, milestones and KPIs; maintain basic reports or dashboards; and compile recurring updates for committee and network leadership.
* Coordinate production of committee and network updates from planning through distribution, including gathering inputs, drafting and editing copy, managing reviews and maintaining the production schedule.
* Gather information from stakeholders and write concise stories that showcase significant client wins, cross-border collaboration and network capabilities in support of BMCC and Go-To-Market (GTM) priorities.
* Assist with planning and delivering committee-sponsored events, webinars, conferences and network meetings, including invitations, materials, speaker coordination, logistics and post-event follow-up.
* Make routine updates to approved global web content and shared resources, check information for accuracy and consistency, and help keep links, files and reference materials current.
* Provide additional coordination, communications and production assistance for BMCC, GTM and other network priorities as needs evolve.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, project management, communications, marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Three to four years of experience in a program coordination, project management or committee support role, preferably within a global, business development, GTM or professional services environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Strong project management and organizational skills, including the ability to manage workplans, deadlines, dependencies, files, reviews and multiple assignments.
* Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to turn stakeholder input, meeting discussions and complex information into clear, concise materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Word and Excel; experience with collaborative project management or document-sharing tools is helpful.
* Experience in leveraging AI and other productivity tools to improve efficiency, coordination and outcomes.
* Comfort working with senior leaders and colleagues across functions, geographies and time zones.
* Professional judgment and discretion when handling committee materials, leadership discussions and business information.
* Experience in a B2B or professional services environment

This position holds expanded accountability for operational monitoring, client relationship management, and issue resolution across multiple accounts or teams. The Group Lead translates client needs into prioritized operational strategies, monitors key performance indicators, identifies systemic risks and trends, and drives timely resolution to protect cash, A/R performance, and client satisfaction.

The role also provides leadership and mentorship to operational leads and staff, reinforcing execution standards, supporting training and performance improvement efforts, and removing barriers to delivery. **Job Description**

**A bit about this role:**

On the Provider Operations team, we are responsible for credentialing the providers and facilities contracting with our health plan. We built our credentialing program from the ground up, and it credentials providers compliantly in industry-leading timeframes. That lets us build new networks quickly, show operational excellence to our providers, and keeps provider data current and accurate.

In our stage of growth, we are focused on implementing AI initiatives and expanding the responsibilities of our offshore team to make our operations faster, more efficient, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Manager of Provider Operations who is a hands-on operator. You’ll be just as comfortable digging into work queues and untangling a messy case as you are redesigning a workflow or rethinking how a process could run with AI. Priorities will shift, and you’ll shift with them.

This is an ideal role for a results-driven leader who is mission driven, process oriented, data obsessed, and energized by change.

***Your responsibilities and impact will include:***

* Supporting day-to-day credentialing operations, including working queues yourself, unblocking complex cases, and driving best-in-class turnaround times and quality.
* Leading the effort to capture our operational knowledge in clear, usable SOPs and building a central documentation library that stays current as processes change.
* Helping manage and develop our offshore team, including training, documentation, and quality and productivity monitoring, with the goal of owning the offshore relationship over time.
* Partnering on offshore transitions by identifying work that can move offshore and supporting smooth handoffs without disrupting turnaround times or compliance.
* Assessing operational pain points and using data to size opportunities and build the business case for new solutions using data insights, including quantifying the impact of AI solutions, tech improvements, and offshore transitions before and after they launch.
* Creating and implementing AI solutions that make operations more efficient and enable scale, partnering with product and engineering where needed and testing, measuring, and refining what you build.
* Playing a key role in our 2027 CVO vendor transition, including workflow mapping, requirements, testing, and cutover, and helping monitor vendor performance once live.
* Becoming an expert in our internal systems and tools so you can troubleshoot issues and propose clear improvements to system logic.
* Owning key operational metrics, building reporting that surfaces trends and bottlenecks, and using data to guide decisions.
* Ensuring credentialing operations remain compliant with CMS, AAAHC, and state requirements as processes and tools evolve.
* Partnering cross-functionally with internal leadership, network and contracting teams, providers, vendors, and offshore partners.

***Required skills and experience:***

* 3-5+ years in operations, process improvement, or consulting.
* A true operator with a bias toward action. You’re willing to roll up your sleeves and do the work, not just direct it.
* A clear head for process. You’re passionate about efficiency and can predict and prevent bottlenecks before they happen.
* Comfort moving quickly between big-picture strategy and detailed, in-the-weeds execution.
* Ability to shift focus and reprioritize quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
* You run toward complexity and have the stamina for hard problems.
* Detail-oriented, with a high bar for quality and accuracy.
* Ability and desire to understand and follow complex regulations.
* Strong communicator who can work with cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment.
* Data, systems, and tech savvy, with the ability to build reporting that improves decision-making.

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Healthcare experience.
* Familiarity with credentialing standards and CMS requirements.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying AI tools to improve workflows, or a strong track record of applying technology and automation to operational problems.
* Experience with process improvement methodologies.

***Salary Range:*** $73,000-$115,000/year
