jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Assembly Software**

Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.

When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned-up industry.

**Vision Statement**

Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime.

**Mission Statement**

Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers.

**Core Values**

* We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency + feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth + learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions + work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative + open-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer + our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service + add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity + Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.

Ask five people on a product team why a launch slipped and you'll get five different partial answers: Engineering thought Product had locked scope, Product assumed Sales already knew what was changing, and Sales is finding out today, from a customer, that something they promised isn't shipping the way they described it. That gap between good people doing good work is where this job lives, and we need someone who can't stand leaving it open.

As the **Senior Product Operations Manager** at Assembly Software, you'd be the product manager for how our Product organization runs. Not a coordinator keeping a status doc updated, and not a process owner for its own sake, but someone who treats how our PMs, designers, and engineers plan, prioritize, launch, and learn as a product in itself, with real customers, real friction points, and real room to get better. You'll build the scorecards leadership can read without asking anyone for an update, run the readiness process that makes sure Sales and Customer Success know what's shipping before it ships, and use AI daily in how you actually work, not as a line in a strategy deck.

We're not hiring this role to keep the trains running on time; we already have that. We want someone who looks at how Product, Engineering, and Design work together and can't help but see exactly what's slowing them down, then goes and fixes it, whether or not it was technically their job. You'll move comfortably between a spreadsheet and a hard conversation with a VP about why a process needs to change, and you'll know when to retire your own mechanism because it's stopped earning its place.

We're fully remote, no surprise return-to-office memo hiding in the offer letter, with medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), and paid parental leave. You'd be joining a small, sharp Product team that takes real pride in what it ships and is ready to hand you real ownership from day one.

If this sounds like the seat you've been waiting for, we'd love to hear from you.

**When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:**

**1. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  
Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

**2. What makes Assembly Software different?**  
Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

**3. What's the benefits package like?**  
Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program

We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**

At Vida, we help people get better- and we're helping the healthcare system get better, too.

Vida is a virtual, personalized obesity care provider that uses evidence-based treatment to help patients manage obesity and related conditions like diabetes, high blood pressure, anxiety and depression. Vida's team of Obesity Medicine-Certified Physicians, Registered Dietitians, Expert Coaches and Licensed Therapists takes a whole-person approach to care, helping people lose weight, reduce stress and improve their overall health.

By combining advanced technology with top-notch healthcare providers, Vida is breaking down the barriers that have historically kept people from getting the best care. It's trusted by Fortune 100 companies, major national payers and large providers to enable their employees to live their healthiest lives.

Vida Health is seeking a high-energy, systems-thinking Senior Operations Program Manager to join our team. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of clinical/product programs and growth initiatives, ensuring our operational infrastructure keeps pace with our commercial expansion and strategic evolution.

This is an execution-focused role. The strategic decisions have largely been made or will be facilitated by senior leadership team members on an ongoing basis; your mission is to ensure they are executed flawlessly. You will own the end-to-end operational coordination of multiple interconnected transformation initiatives while simultaneously building the frameworks necessary to sustain our growth.

### **Responsibilities:**

* Own and maintain the integrated program plan across multiple major initiatives, tracking workstreams, milestones, owners, dependencies, and status tracking across a dozen-plus functional teams.
* Connect strategic growth initiatives with operational reality, ensuring downstream product, billing, and communication changes align with marketing and user-acquisition goals.
* Drive alignment and sequence workflows across Operations, Product, Clinical, Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Legal, and Client Success teams.
* Stand up and maintain governance structures, including steering committee cadences, working group charters, escalation paths, and decision logs. Run weekly rollout operations meetings.
* Drive key readiness items to completion, including clinical programs/protocols, client billing/invoicing, member communications, outcomes measurement, and service model cost structures.
* Identify, surface, and escalate cross-functional bottlenecks early. Maintain a running "blocked list" for executive review and know when to leverage executive sponsorship to unblock items.

* Bachelor's degree with a concentration in Business or Communications.
* 8+ years of program/project management, operations, or implementation experience. Must have a proven track record in a growth-stage startup environment (Series B–D) and at least one engagement involving a complex, multi-workstream organizational transformation.

jobs.title: Client Experience Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.

**THE ROLE**

Zeta Global is looking for an experienced and proactive Client Experience Operations Manager to support the delivery of media dashboards and audience creation (1PD and pixel) across multiple client accounts. This role requires strong project coordination skills, attention to detail, organization, a deep understanding of digital media performance, and hands-on familiarity with tagging and pixel tracking technologies. You’ll work closely with Strategic Directors, analytics teams, and operations to ensure that tracking infrastructure is in place to provide accurate, actionable media insights across diverse verticals. Our main job function is to project manage various deliverables for our agency clients.

*Depending on your location, this role could be hybrid (NYC, Nashville, LA, San Francisco) or fully remote in this US.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Multi-Account Project Management**

* Support the Program Director on end-to-end project execution for media dashboard builds and enhancements across a portfolio of client accounts.
* Develop and maintain timelines, deliverables, and status documentation across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between internal teams (media, analytics, ops and sales) and clients for tracking- and dashboard-related deliverables.
* Anticipate and manage resource constraints and shifting client priorities in a fast-paced setting

**Media Attribution & Tracking Oversight**

* Collaborate with the ops and analytics teams to ensure proper tagging and tracking is in place to execute projects
* Oversee the implementation and validation of pixels/tags across media platforms and client web properties using tools like Google Tag Manager or Adobe
* Coordinate with third-party vendors/agencies (e.g., Meta, DV360, TikTok, Campaign Manager 360) to ensure accurate data flows and media tracking.

**Dashboard Planning & Execution**

* Translate client reporting needs into data requirements and dashboard specifications.
* Potentially work with BI or data visualization teams to build or customize dashboards in tools such as Looker, Datorama, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Maintain QA processes to ensure data integrity and proper attribution across channels (paid search, paid social, display, video, programmatic, etc.).
* Manage versioning and enhancements as campaign needs evolve.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Facilitate client communications for project milestones, data readiness, and dashboard walkthroughs.
* Document tagging requirements and dashboard logic for cross-functional transparency.
* Quarterback the internal communication between the teams (sales, data cloud, analytics, ops) to ensure projects are completed on time

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or Data/Analytics-related field; project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) is a plus.
* 3–5 years of project management experience, with at least 2 years in a marketing/advertising agency environment.
* Understanding of digital media channels (SEM, display, social, programmatic, video) and attribution mechanics.
* Familiarity with **tag/pixel management platforms** and third-party tracking integrations (GTM, Adobe Launch, Campaign Manager, Meta, etc.).
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with an ability to manage timelines across multiple stakeholders and projects.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Exposure to multiple attribution models and how they apply to client KPIs.
* Experience working with marketing analytics platforms (GA4, Adobe Analytics, CM360).
* Understanding of UTM parameters, conversion events, and media taxonomy standards.

**What You'll Bring to Zeta:**

* The ability to juggle multiple client projects without sacrificing quality or clarity.
* A proactive approach to solving tracking or data discrepancies before they become client issues.
* A collaborative spirit that helps media, analytics, and ops teams stay in sync.
* An eye for clean, clear reporting that connects media spend to measurable outcomes.

**BENEFITS & PERKS**

* Unlimited PTO
* Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
* Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

**SALARY RANGE**

The salary range for this role is $75,000 - $90,000, depending on location and experience.

**PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA**

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

Remote - must reside and work legally in the U.S. All work must be performed within the U.S.

**About CCU**

Colorado Christian University is the premier interdenominational Christian university in Colorado and the Rocky Mountain region, delivering world class education to thousands of students. The fully accredited, nonprofit university is located in Lakewood, Colorado, a suburb of Denver.

Colorado Christian University was founded in 1914. CCU’s motto is grace and truth. This motto comes from John 1.14: “And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, and we have seen His glory, the glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth,” (ESV).

CCU's mission is Christ-centered higher education transforming students to impact the world with grace and truth.

Colorado Christian University cultivates knowledge and love of God in a Christ-centered community of learners and scholars, with an enduring commitment to the integration of exemplary academics, spiritual formation, and engagement with the world. We envision graduates who think critically and creatively, lead with high ethical and professional standards, embody the character and compassion of Jesus Christ, treasure the gospel, and who thereby are prepared to impact the world in their callings.

CCU embraces an educational model that was present at the foundation of many of the great Western and American universities. It is made up of three pillars — competence, character, and Christ-centered faith. Secular universities have abandoned two of those pillars. We think this is a major oversight that eventually undermines education. Furthermore, we believe this classical educational model is both life-giving and greatly needed in our time.

A leader in higher education, CCU has been consistently ranked in the top 2% of colleges and universities nationwide for its core curriculum by the American Council of Trustees and Alumni. CCU has had 11 consecutive years of enrollment growth and has been named one of the five fastest-growing master’s granting universities by *The Chronicle of Higher Education.*

CCU offers more than 200 degree program options for traditional and adult students through its two colleges — the College of Undergraduate Studies and College of Adult and Graduate Studies. More than 17,000 students attend the University on the main campus, online, and through CCU Academy.

**What is most appealing about working at CCU?**

* Faith-friendly: CCU’s culture is unique to higher education. Where else can you pursue academic excellence yet read the Holy Bible, pray with teammates and students at work, and work to impact our culture in support of Christian values?
* Convictionally Christian: As a university, we have an enduring commitment to Christ, His kingdom and the truth of God’s Word.
* Live out your calling: We are a traditional evangelical university where you can invest your God-given talents and abilities alongside coworkers and teammates, while having a profound influence on students as they deepen their relationship with Jesus Christ.
* Equip students for kingdom work: You can be a part of helping students discover their callings and preparing them for positions of significant leadership in the church, business, government, education, and other professions, as a key part of our University's Strategic Priorities.

**We’re looking for candidates who have:**

* A bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, business, journalism, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience, is required.
* Outstanding time-management and organizational skills are essential, as well as professional knowledge of higher education, an understanding of marketing communications in print, digital, and social media environments, and a willingness to learn style rules, including Associated Press (AP) style.
* A solid commitment to building and fostering collaborative relationships with internal clients, designers, project managers, vendors, and other CCS staff.
* A strong work ethic, self-motivated, and able to work well independently and with teams.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, quality, multi-tasking, and customer service.

* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and interviewing skills.

* Ability to meet immediate and changing deadlines, work with multiple clients, and meet the highest professional standards.

In this role, you will serve as the lead point of contact for transitioning complex Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and integrated infrastructure projects from contract signing to final commissioning.
  
  
As a principal individual contributor, you will directly oversee the execution of Ford Energy's most strategic and complex deployments while helping to shape and apply standardized PMO processes, delivery playbooks, and stage-gate controls for the organization. This role requires disciplined project management, proactive communication, and strong cross-functional coordination to bring each sale to life and deliver a seamless aftersales customer experience.

What you'll do...
  
  
1. Delivery Process Execution:

* Standardized Execution: Apply and help continuously improve standardized post-contract delivery processes, playbooks, and stage-gate reviews tailored for BESS projects.
* Project Health: Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) for project health, delivery efficiency, and financial performance across assigned Ford Energy projects.
* Tools & Systems: Utilize and provide feedback on advanced program management tools and tracking systems to ensure consistent execution.

2. High-Stakes Project Execution:

* Direct Delivery: Take personal accountability for the execution, timeline, and commissioning of Ford Energy's utility-scale BESS installations.
* Risk Mitigation: Conduct rigorous stakeholder and risk analyses to identify deployment hurdles and coordinate cross-functional interventions to unblock delivery pipelines.
* Technical & Operational Alignment: Act as the primary interface between Sales, Service, Engineering, Finance, and external EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) contractors to ensure aligned execution.

3. Stakeholder & Customer Management:

* Primary Escalation Contact: Serve as the prime operational contact and consultant for customers, utilities, and senior internal leadership during project deployment.
* Contractual Coordination: Navigate and resolve complex contractual, scheduling, and technical coordination issues with external partners and utility representatives.
* Peer Mentorship: Provide functional guidance and mentorship to other project specialists and engineers across the organization.

You'll have...
  
Experience:

* 3–5+ years of project or program management experience, preferably in post-contract project execution, EPC workflows, contract management, field operations, commissioning, energy, or engineering-adjacent industries.
* Prior experience with utility-scale (BESS) project deployments.
* Proven ability to influence and drive consensus across matrixed, cross-functional engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Prior experience translating commercial commitments or technical requirements into executable implementation and service plans.

Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Core Skills & Mindset:

* Process-Oriented Executor: Able to apply and reinforce standardized project delivery frameworks and PMO guidelines, ensuring operational readiness for complex deployments.
* Collaborative Facilitator: Skilled at bridging gaps and building operational consensus between Sales, Aftersales, Engineering, Finance, and external partners to drive aligned execution.
* Execution Champion: Maintains a hands-on, relentless focus on delivery timelines, quality, and project financials, ensuring our most complex commitments to customers are met successfully.
* Team Contributor: Passionate about sharing knowledge and elevating project delivery capabilities across the organization, with the readiness to foster a collaborative team culture as the function grows.

Location & Travel:

* Location: Remote or Dearborn, MI. This position operates on a hybrid model, requiring regular onsite presence to collaborate with engineering, sales, aftersales, and manufacturing team members.
* Travel Expectations: Moderate domestic travel to project sites, customer offices, and supplier locations as needed to oversee critical execution milestones.

You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply!

**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

**Location**: Remote - US Only

**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Implementation Manager, Enterprise owns end-to-end delivery of First Due's Enterprise implementation programs, the largest and most complex engagements in the US customer base. These are multi-module, multi-phase deployments for large fire and EMS agencies, involving computer-aided dispatch integrations, significant historical data migration from legacy records management systems, and layered stakeholder environments spanning command staff, information technology, the dispatch center, EMS, fire prevention, training, labor representation, and municipal government.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The Implementation Manager coordinates a delivery team of Implementation Consultants and Technical Services resources, owns the program plan and the customer relationship, and is accountable for delivery quality, timeline integrity, and scope control across an assigned portfolio. The role is expected to run programs on formal project management discipline and to use AI tooling to remove routine work from delivery so that judgment, domain expertise, and executive presence carry the majority of the incumbent's time.

### ***AI-enabled delivery***

* Use First Due's AI tooling to remove routine delivery work, including status drafting, meeting summarization and action item capture, first-pass plan generation, and risk synthesis across concurrent workstreams.

Role Summary
  
  
NVA is building a dedicated implementation capability to ensure operational improvements, process and policy enhancements, and other field-facing changes are deployed consistently, adopted effectively, and sustained across Field Operations and Hospitals as the business continues to scale.
  
  
The Field Implementation Manager is the execution arm of the Implementation & Enablement function for an assigned region. Reporting to the Sr Manager Implementation, this role activates non-medical, non-technology initiatives across Field Operations and Hospitals by turning approved direction into clear, practical action and supporting teams through deployment. The Field Implementation Manager is a trusted field-facing activator, listener, and trainer—distilling what matters for each audience, delivering effective training and communication, and helping leaders understand both the business need and what it means for day-to-day operations.

**Location:** Remote  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt

DAS Health is a leading provider of healthcare IT and management solutions, serving ambulatory, senior care, and post-acute organizations nationwide. We combine deep healthcare expertise with innovative technology solutions to help our clients operate more efficiently, securely, and effectively. Our team is passionate about improving patient care through reliable, scalable, and secure technology.  
  
**Position Summary**  
The Senior Technical Project Manager leads highly complex, enterprise-level technical projects for DAS Health’s top healthcare and senior care clients. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of high-impact initiatives, ensuring projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget. The ideal candidate brings advanced project management expertise, strong technical acumen, and the ability to successfully manage multiple high-stakes projects in dynamic environments.

* Own the planning, execution, and delivery of high-priority, complex technical projects for enterprise healthcare and senior care clients.
* Manage internal and external project teams to ensure milestones, timelines, and deliverables remain on track.
* Lead project meetings and own all project-related communications, including status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder updates.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.

* 10+ years of experience in technical project management supporting enterprise-level clients.
* Proven experience delivering complex MSP, Cloud, and Cyber projects on time and within budget, including onboardings, migrations, and offboardings.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to influence and drive results across all levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated success managing budgets, schedules, and resource planning in fast-paced, evolving environments.
* Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with healthcare clients and cross-functional internal partners.

* Opportunity to work with leading healthcare organizations on high-impact, mission-critical initiatives

jobs.title: Delivery Operations Lead (3-Month Contract)
jobs.description:
Growth is a system rather than a collection of marketing services, and that belief is what earned Halstead Media Group a spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. We're a Growth Operations partner built specifically for the landscape industry, and our work spans demand generation, CRM, sales process, reporting and the connections between them, so that landscape companies can see how opportunities are created, moved through the pipeline and turned into revenue.

As our contract Delivery Operations Lead, you'll spend the next three months making sure every piece of client work, from websites and paid media to SEO, design, copy and reporting, has an owner, a realistic timeline and a budget that holds, so our team of about 30 can keep delivering at the standard our clients expect. The process and the tools are already in place, so this is a hands-on role for someone who loves bringing order to a busy queue and wants to be routing work and making priority calls from the first week. This position is 100% remote.

*Remote - Contract, about 25 hours a week*

**What you'll do day to day**
-----------------------------

* Own the intake queue in Scoro and assign every new task to the right person within one business day, so nothing sits without an owner
* Match work to people based on capacity, skill fit, priority, dependencies and budget
* Make sure every task is ready to start, with the brief, assets and approvals in place, before it reaches the team
* Keep one prioritized delivery queue across every client and department, and be the go-to answer for who is doing what and by when
* Set and adjust timelines based on real capacity and complexity, and bring tradeoff decisions about what moves, what waits and what gets re-scoped to our VP of Client Success
* Keep a live view of workload across project management, copy, design, development, SEO and paid media, and rebalance work as priorities and availability shift
* Track budgeted versus actual hours on active projects and flag anything trending over budget while there's still time to adjust
* Map handoffs from strategy to copy to design to development to launch, and clear bottlenecks by chasing decisions and re-sequencing work
* Run a short daily dispatch and triage huddle and a weekly delivery health review that sorts work into on track, at risk and off track, with a clear next action for each
* Escalate budget overages, timeline risks and blockers early, and stay with them until they're resolved
* Keep Scoro's statuses, queues and assignments clean, and deliver a weekly report on delivery performance, completed projects with budget versus actual, and timeline status
* Keep the delivery numbers on our company scorecard accurate and on time
* Work hand in hand with our Project Managers and department leads on priorities, client commitments, staffing and quality

**How you'll know you're doing an amazing job**
-----------------------------------------------

Every part of our delivery should contribute to the same goals and be measured against them, and this role is how the whole team keeps score.

* Every new task has an owner within one business day
* More of our work is delivered within its budgeted hours
* On-time delivery climbs, and launch dates hold
* Risks surface early, well before they touch a deadline or a client
* Weekly and monthly forecasts line up with what actually happens
* The weekly delivery report goes out on time, accurate and with clear next steps
* Project Managers and department leads come to you first when priorities collide
* The team says the queue feels calmer and clearer than it did when you started

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Experience running delivery operations, resourcing or traffic management at an agency or professional services firm
* A love for dispatching and load balancing across several teams at once, and the confidence to make fast prioritization calls
* Comfort tracking budget versus actual hours and forecasting capacity
* Hands-on experience with a work management platform such as Scoro, Asana, Monday, Teamwork or Workamajig, with Scoro a strong plus
* A calm, steady approach when priorities compete, and a knack for simple systems that people actually follow
* Comfort using AI tools like Claude in your day-to-day workflow
* **Bonus:** agency experience

**Contract details**
--------------------

* **Length:** about 3 months, starting as soon as possible
* **Hours:** about 25 hours a week, spread across weekdays so that dispatch happens daily
* **Type:** independent contractor (1099)
* **Location:** 100% remote, US based
* **Reports to:** Lauren Cullnan, VP of Client Success
* **Rate:** $32-$36/hour

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Claude Corps (Fellow Experience)
jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.  
  
We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.  
  
We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

**Location:** Remote (U.S.), with regular travel for in-person events
  
**Role type:** Full-time
  
**Reports to:** Kelly Mosher, Program Lead, Claude Corps  
**Compensation:** $130,000 to $155,000

**About Claude Corps**

In June 2026, Anthropic and CodePath launched Claude Corps, a $150M national fellowship. It places 1,000 paid, AI-skilled fellows in 12-month roles at mission-driven organizations across the country. Anthropic funds the program and sets strategy. CodePath employs the fellows and leads their training and programming.

The program is growing fast. Cohort 1 started in October 2026 with 100 fellows. Cohort 2 starts in March 2027 with 300. Cohort 3 starts in late summer 2027 with 600. Many fellows relocate to a new city for the year, so their experience, from offer letter to last day, decides whether the program works.

**About the role**

You'll be the Program Lead's right hand: a senior program manager who can take a whole area of Claude Corps, set the plan, and run it without being managed day to day. That frees Kelly to focus on program operations and strategy across the fellowship.

Your first area is the **fellow experience**, which today has no single end-to-end owner. You'll own how we communicate with, connect, and gather fellows, from offer through their last day. As the program scales, your scope will shift to wherever the biggest gap is. That could mean host organization experience or another part of the program, and future hires (for example, a community manager) may report to you.

This is a generalist role by design. We're hiring for strong program management judgment, not a single specialty.

**What success looks like**

**First 30 days: learn it and take the wheel**

* Get to know Cohort 1 (100 fellows live now), the mentor team, and our Anthropic partners
* Map the fellow journey from offer to day one, and name the three biggest gaps
* Take over day-to-day fellow communications (program inbox, fellow Slack, regular updates) from your manager
* Lock the Cohort 2 onboarding plan for 300 fellows: timeline, host matching updates, and relocation guidance

**Days 31 to 60: deliver Cohort 2 Basecamp**

* Run the week-long Cohort 2 Basecamp kickoff (starting Feb 22) with our event agency and curriculum team. You'll own the run of show, attendee experience, and on-site problem solving
* Get every Cohort 2 fellow from signed offer to day one with clear, consistent communication

**Days 61 to 90: build for scale**

* Launch a fellow support model that a small team can run for 1,000 fellows: self-serve resources, AI-assisted answers, and clear escalation to mentors, HR, and program leads
* Stand up community rituals and peer structures that don't depend on you to run
* Report engagement, satisfaction, and retention to CodePath and Anthropic leadership

**6 to 12 months**

* Cohort 3 (600 fellows) onboards on playbooks you wrote, with fewer people and fewer hours than Cohort 2
* You've documented what works so another team could pick it up and run it
* You've taken on a second program area where we need it most

**What you'll do**

* **Own the plan.** Set direction for your program area, make clear trade-offs, and tie the work to outcomes like fellow retention and engagement
* **Run the details.** Keep many workstreams moving at once and close loops without reminders
* **Communicate well.** Set honest expectations with fellows, keep the Claude Corps voice consistent, and keep host organizations informed in coordination with Anthropic's host team
* **Build systems, not heroics.** Use AI, including Claude, every day, and choose tools that let a small team serve thousands of people
* **Partner widely.** Work closely with the mentor team, curriculum, HR, outside vendors, and Anthropic partners

**What we're looking for**

**Required**

* 7+ years in program management, including owning a cohort-based program, fellowship, or member community end to end
* You've set direction for a program area yourself, not only carried out someone else's plan
* You can show how you run a heavy, changing workload: your system, what slipped once, and what you changed afterward
* You've moved work from manual to systematic, and you use AI tools hands-on in your daily work
* You write clearly and warmly and adjust your tone for fellows, executives, and partners
* You can travel to multi-day events several times a year, including February and late summer 2027

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in two or more of: participant communications, community building, or large in-person events with an outside agency
* Fellowships, service programs like AmeriCorps, or early-career talent programs
* Supporting participants through a relocation or major life transition
* Experience at a nonprofit, in education, or at a fast-growing startup

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist - Procurement Solutions
jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

Bluesight is seeking an experienced Implementation Specialist to lead client implementations of Procurement Solutions, which includes CostCheck, ShortageCheck and 340BCheck. CostCheck, our pharmacy purchasing and cost-savings optimization solution. CostCheck helps hospitals maximize pharmacy savings opportunities by monitoring spend against savings caps, GPO contract terms, and 340B program requirements. ShortageCheck predicts hospital and pharmacy drug shortages up to 90 days in advance, using market-wide signals — fulfillment delays, demand surges, usage trends — from over 3,250 healthcare organizations to give your team the lead time to plan ahead instead of scrambling once patient care is at risk. 340BCheck340BCheck unifies 340B data in one compliance command center, built on real HRSA audit requirements, so hospitals and grantees stay continuously audit-ready as their program grows. This is a role on the Implementation team, suited to someone who has already worked in hospital pharmacy purchasing or cost-savings optimization, and can bring that domain depth directly into how our customers configure and adopt Procurement solutions.

As a member of the team, this person will manage the most complex implementations — configuring systems to maximize potentials and fill gaps , and setting customers up on sound methodology from day one — act as a trusted advisor to customers' purchasing and pharmacy leadership, and help mentor other Implementation Specialists on purchasing-, supply- and cost-related workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly attentive to detail, comfortable talking with pharmacy buyers, purchasing directors, and finance stakeholders, and can operate in an environment that is often ambiguous and requires creativity to resolve issues.

### **Representative Duties & Responsibilities**

* Manage all aspects of Procurement Solution implementation projects, including project kick-off, software and pricing/contract configuration, go-live, and training, while maintaining project timelines.
* Configure and validate data, system outcomes, workflows, , and wholesaler/purchasing data feeds so customers' performance is tracked accurately from go-live.
* Act as the main point of contact for customers before they go live, owning all communications including weekly check-in meetings, ad hoc calls, and emails.
* Manage multiple implementation projects at once, across customers with different priorities, purchasing structures, and deadlines.
* Work as a consultative partner with customers' purchasing and pharmacy teams, advising on best practices for pharmacy cost-savings optimization, 340B compliance, and GPO/contract alignment.
* Train customer stakeholders on the CostCheck savings methodology and how to interpret savings-vs-cap performance so they're self-sufficient after go-live.
* Train customer stakeholders on the 340BCheck compliance and audit workflows within the system to provide them assistance in HRSA audits.
* Train customer stakeholders on ShortageCheck use and medication tracking.
* Act as a liaison between the customer, wholesalers/GPOs, and Bluesight's internal Clinical, Product, and Dev teams to facilitate technical and pricing configuration of the software.
* Maintain up-to-date project plans, tickets, and other project documentation so timelines stay on track and visible to leadership.
* Serve as a senior resource for the Implementation team on purchasing- and cost-related questions, helping onboard and support other Implementation Specialists.
* Travel to customer sites as needed to support rollout, meet with key stakeholders, and represent Bluesight professionally in front of customers.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, pharmacy, healthcare management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* 5+ years of professional experience, with a background aligned to hospital pharmacy purchasing, buying, procurement, or pharmacy cost-savings optimization (e.g., experience as a buyer or in a similar purchasing-facing role).
* 2+ years of project management and/or client-facing experience, ideally implementation-related.
* Strong familiarity with pharmacy cost savings programs, 340B program requirements, and group purchasing organizations (GPOs) preferred.
* Experience in the healthcare industry, ideally hospital pharmacy or health-system purchasing.
* Strong financial and data analysis skills, with the ability to assess savings performance and identify optimization opportunities during implementation.
* Ability to adapt to change, think quickly, and work independently.
* Team-player attitude and a willingness to get things done, including mentoring less-senior teammates.
* High attention to detail.
* Ability to build trusting, communicative, and results-oriented relationships with customers, including purchasing and finance stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills.
* ***Willingness and ability to travel within the US as needed.***

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) credentials a strong plus.
* ACE certification a strong plus.
* Excel and SQL skills a plus.
* Previous experience with EMRs/ADCs (e.g., EPIC and Cerner) or purchasing/wholesaler platforms a plus.

jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.

A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.

  

Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

InCommand is in daily use today across Serverfarm's own data centers and by the customers who operate in them. Behind it is the InCommand Operations team, our service desk: the people who bring every new site and customer onto the platform, keep its record of each facility accurate, support the teams who rely on it every day, and produce the reporting our customers depend on. That work carries on while the next generation of the product is built, and the operational knowledge this team holds is what the new product is built from.

As Ops Lead you manage that team and work alongside it. This is a hands-on management role: you know in detail how each of the team's processes works, from the way a new site is modeled to the way a customer request is resolved, and you can step into any of them yourself. You lead the implementation projects that bring new customers and sites onto the platform and serve as the customer's main technical contact while they run, and you grow the team as the business grows. You partner closely with Integrations and the development teams.

### **Key Accountabilities**

* Manage the InCommand Operations team day to day: set priorities, coach and develop each engineer, conduct performance reviews, and recruit as the team grows.

* Own the team's operating standards. Know every process in detail, keep the procedures documented and current, and make sure each new hire is trained to the same standard.

* Lead the onboarding of new customers and sites from kickoff through go-live, planning and scheduling each implementation, running the working sessions with the customer, tracking risks, reporting progress, and clearing whatever stands in the way.

* Build each site's record in InCommand from its construction documents and a walk of the floor: spaces, racks, the power path from utility to rack, cooling, devices and cross-connects, reconciled against what is actually installed. Prepare and load the bulk-upload worksheets, and work with Integrations to define and validate the telemetry points each site requires.

* Use AI assistants and automation to turn drawings, asset lists and field notes into structured, validated data, build repeatable extraction and validation workflows for the whole team, and audit existing site data to find and resolve discrepancies.

* Support Serverfarm sites and customers in their daily use of the platform: power capacity monitoring, space and rack layouts, device lifecycle and moves, adds and changes, ports and cross-connects and the billing that depends on them, CMMS asset tracking and preventive maintenance scheduling, walk-around checklists, critical spares, and monthly customer reporting. Train customers and site teams so that the service desk is their first call.

* Represent the users to the development teams: reproduce and document defects, write enhancement requests with clear acceptance criteria, test releases before they reach customers, and keep the help documentation current.

### **Required Skills**

* 5+ years in or around data centers (operations, critical facilities, IT infrastructure or DCIM), including 2+ years formally managing engineers or technicians, with responsibility for priorities, coaching, performance reviews and hiring.

* You have led projects end to end, coordinating with internal teams and external customers, owning scope, schedule, stakeholders and status.

* You have worked with SCADA systems (BMS and EPMS) and read and interpreted data center construction documents: single-line diagrams, floor plans, rack elevations and panel schedules.

* You use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) every day to extract, structure and validate data, and you have built prompts and automations.

* You have strong data skills: advanced Excel and Power Query, SQL, and structured formats such as CSV and JSON.

* You communicate plainly, lead customer working sessions with confidence, and explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.

* You work hard problems through to resolution on your own initiative, and you bring a specific question when you need help.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Worked with a DCIM, DCFM or CMMS platform (Nlyte, Sunbird, Hyperview, MCIM or similar).

* Written scripts in Python or PowerShell and worked with REST APIs.

* Supported colocation customers directly, including their reporting and billing data.

* Earned an ITIL or PMP certification.

### **Compensation**

**COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION PACKAGE BETWEEN SALARY, BONUS + BENEFITS**

Serverfarm is committed to providing an equal opportunity workplace and offers paid time off, paid holidays, 401k and FULL coverage medical, dental and vision. Our compensation philosophy rewards employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned with the company’s goals and strategic initiatives.

The listed salary range for this position is an estimate based on the competitive job market. Final compensation will be based on your own individual skill

jobs.description:
Looking for work that matters? Join Viant and contribute to the design and manufacturing of medical technologies that improve patient outcomes. Guided by our promise—We’re In It For Life—you’ll build your career with a trusted industry innovator that invests in your growth, well-being, and ability to make a meaningful impact every day.

jobs.title: Clinical & PACS Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Engagement Overview

The Contractor bridges client facilities, clinical staff and technology systems. Working with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations as the primary point of contact, the Contractor provides daytime PACS administration, clinical client and physician coordination, and physician scheduling support.

The Contractor also anchors after-hours support by covering a light on-call rotation (1 week in every 6) and serving as the technical escalation resource for the after-hours administration team. Services outside this scope are added only by mutual written agreement.

Scope of Services

The Contractor is responsible for the results below and determines the methods, sequence and tools used to deliver them.

1. PACS Administration & Technical Support

* Provide daytime administration of the Company's PACS platforms, including study routing, verification and uninterrupted diagnostic workflow.
* Resolve study matching errors, Sirona tickets, missing prior studies and image quality tickets.
* Work with PACS/IT vendors, modality technologists and reading physicians to resolve modality worklist failures, hanging protocol errors and viewer discrepancies.
* Monitor study queues across all clinical feeds so turnaround-time SLAs are consistently met.

2. Clinical Client & Physician Liaison

* Act as a primary operational contact for clients, referring providers and the Company's radiologists on report turnaround, stat read coordination and protocol questions.
* Support physician scheduling, including complex specialty exam schedules, add-on reads and subspecialty physician assignments.
* Facilitate direct communication between referring clinicians and on-duty radiologists.
* Track recurring client issues, report them to the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations with recommended service improvements, and maintain client preference cards.

3. Escalation Support & After-Hours On-Call

* Provide primary after-hours on-call coverage 1 week in every 6, handling urgent intake and technical issue resolution.
* Serve as the daytime technical escalation point for the after-hours administration team, including knowledge transfer on PACS troubleshooting.
* Deliver updates to standard operating procedures (SOPs), after-hours call sheets, PACS troubleshooting playbooks and FAQs.

Coverage Commitments

The Contractor commits to two coverage windows; within them, the Contractor sets their own working hours and methods.

* **Business-day coverage:** Available to respond to client, physician and PACS issues Monday–Friday during core business hours.
* **On-call coverage:** Primary after-hours on-call 1 week on, 5 weeks off, on a rotation calendar agreed in advance with the Senior Manager, Clinical Operations. The Contractor may arrange a swap with another qualified rotation member, with notice.

Contractor Qualifications

* **Experience:** 5+ years in medical imaging, healthcare administration or clinical operations. Direct radiology operations experience, including PACS workflows, is required.
* **Technical knowledge:** Strong command of PACS workflow, HL7 messaging flows, imaging modalities (CT, MRI, X-ray, US) and HIPAA compliance standards.
* **Communication:** Strong problem-solving and de-escalation skills. Able to translate technical PACS problems into plain clinical terms for providers and to coordinate respectfully with physicians and clients.
* **Availability:** Able to cover the after-hours remote on-call rotation on a 1-week-on, 5-weeks-off cycle.
* **Business setup:** Operates as an independent business with their own phone and reliable internet connection. The Company provides a secured computer for HIPAA compliance.

Engagement Terms

These terms summarize the Independent Contractor Agreement; the signed agreement governs.

* **Independent status:** The Contractor is not an employee and is not eligible for Company benefits.
* **Fees and invoicing:** $70,000 annually, paid as $5,833.33 per month against a monthly invoice. On-call weeks are included in the fee.
* **Taxes and insurance:** The Contractor is responsible for their own income and self-employment taxes and any business licenses or insurance. The Company issues Form 1099-NEC annually.
* **Tools and workspace:** The Company provides a secured, HIPAA-compliant computer and credentials to the PACS and client-facing systems needed to perform the services. The Contractor provides their own phone, internet and workspace.
* **Other clients:** The Contractor may provide services to other businesses, as long as that work does not breach confidentiality, conflict with Company clients or interfere with the coverage commitments above.
* **HIPAA and confidentiality:** The Contractor signs a Business Associate Agreement and confidentiality agreement before receiving system access.

Pay: $70,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Insignia Federal Group is a woman-owned small business providing personalized consulting services to private and public sector clients. Its expertise includes professional IT services, program management, training, and acquisition support.

**Job Summary**

Insignia Federal Group is a professional consulting firm headquartered in McLean, Virginia. We have an excellent opportunity for a **Quality Assurance Analyst** to support a federal government client. This role involves ensuring the quality, accessibility, and usability of large-scale federal websites and web applications through manual and automated testing within an Agile delivery environment. The Quality Assurance Analyst should be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable engaging early in the development cycle, reviewing requirements, building test cases before development is complete, and validating finished work against acceptance criteria. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, developers, UI/UX designers, and federal stakeholders to deliver reliable, standards-compliant digital experiences.

**Successful Candidate:**

**Test Planning & Requirements Analysis**

* 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance for web-based applications.
* Independently review user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and UI/UX designs to identify test scenarios, missing requirements, dependencies, and potential risks.
* Develop and maintain organized test plans, suites, and test cases grouped by application functionality, features, and components, with traceability to Jira tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare test cases proactively during backlog refinement and development, rather than waiting until features are ready for QA.
* Design positive, negative, and exploratory test scenarios to validate both documented requirements and unexpected application behavior.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts and developers to clarify ambiguities and ensure requirements are sufficiently testable before implementation is complete.

**Manual & Automated Testing**

* Perform hands-on functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of web applications and interactive website functionality.
* Prioritize testing and retesting of active sprint deliverables to support code-freeze and release commitments.
* Designing and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks is a plus.
* Perform targeted regression testing after bug fixes to identify unintended impacts on related functionality.
* Validate functionality across browsers, devices, screen sizes, and user interaction scenarios.

**Accessibility & Usability Testing**

* Strong working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.
* Experience conducting accessibility testing using web tools (e.g., ANDI or JAWS) and manual methods.
* Experience identifying usability issues and communicating them clearly to design and development teams.

**Content Management Systems**

* Experience testing websites built on Drupal or other enterprise content management systems.
* Familiarity with CMS workflows, content types, and publishing processes.
* Experience validating interactive web application functionality, including user inputs, form validation, search/filter behavior, conditional workflows, data-driven results, and third-party integrations.

**Defect Management**

* Independently investigate and document defects with clear steps and relevant details.
* Create, track, and maintain defects in Jira, linking findings to the appropriate user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases.
* Work directly with developers to resolve issues, validate corrections, and perform regression testing before closing defects.
* Proactively communicate critical defects, testing blockers, coverage gaps, and release risks to the development and delivery teams.

**Agile Delivery & Collaboration**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.
* Proficient with Jira and Confluence for defect tracking, test management, and documentation.
* Ability to write clear, reproducible defect reports and work collaboratively with developers through resolution.
* Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and communicating test results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications:** MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN OR AUTHORIZED TO WORK IN THE U.S. WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or four or more years of equivalent professional experience in software quality assurance. Must be detail-oriented with strong analytical, written communication, and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a fast-paced federal delivery environment. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting federal government websites or digital modernization programs
* DHS Section 508 Trusted Tester certification
* ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification
* Familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS)
* Experience with visual regression testing tools
* Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman

This role serves as the primary marketing point of contact for Prize Operations teams and is a pivotal role for the success of XPRIZE competitions.

**Responsibilities**

* **Marketing Campaign Strategy:** Partner with other marketing and Prize Operations teams to develop integrated campaigns that build awareness and engagement for prizes, programs, and the foundation. Define measurable objectives, target audience, and associated calls to action for each campaign; and provide regular reporting to stakeholders tracking progress and performance against objectives.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Build and nurture relationships with internal and external stakeholders across programs, including prize/program teams, sponsors, partners, judges, and advisors. Navigate competing stakeholder priorities to ensure that marketing campaigns are aligned with prize objectives and business priorities. Provide marketing-specific prize and program updates to stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Leverage project management skills and the PM tool of record to ensure that event and campaign deliverables are completed in a timely manner, and all stakeholders are updated on progress, risks, and challenges.
* **Communications:** In partnership with the Communications and Creative teams, contribute to the development of key messaging for programs and prize-related content, as well as communications resources for external stakeholders.
* **Events:** In partnership with the Experiential team, contribute to the planning and execution of events to support campaign objectives. Develop marketing materials to support foundation, program, and prize milestone events. Collaborate with Prize Operations teams to develop materials to support XPRIZE presence at industry conferences and events.
* **Budgeting and Resource Management:** Support the development and management of prize marketing budgets, including classifying actuals and tracking actuals against budget and forecast.
* **Marketing Technology:** Leverage marketing-specific tools and technology to manage marketing campaigns and associated projects; measure campaign performance; develop and refine target audiences; and gather social media insights.
* **Trendspotting:** Stay up-to-date on prize/program-related news and industry trends, proactively identifying opportunities to incorporate trends into active and upcoming campaigns.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of proven experience developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies that unify messaging across a variety of channels
* 4-year college or university degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms
* The ability to combine technical/scientific information with emotion to form a compelling message across multiple audiences
* Experience in developing cross-channel marketing campaigns consisting of clear, measurable objectives, well-defined target audience(s), and associated calls to action
* Experience monitoring campaign performance, gathering data insights, and preparing reports to evaluate campaign efficiency, proposing changes to optimize campaigns as needed
* Strong organizational and project management skills to handle multiple tasks, manage campaigns from development to launch, and ensure timely delivery of campaign deliverables
* Experience with creating and managing budgets, including budget tracking and reporting
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive collaboration across teams to maximize impact and drive business results
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence without authority, manage competing priorities, address concerns, and work closely and collaboratively with colleagues and staff
* Passion for the mission of XPRIZE and the work we are doing to build a better future
* Having a growth mindset and a passion for continuous improvement is essential

**Why Work at XPRIZE:**  
In addition to working for a mission-driven company that catalyzes industries, pushes innovation forward, and is creating an abundant and equitable future, we offer the following benefits:

* Remote-first environment (must live and work in the United States)
* Quarterly company-paid All-Hands meetings in Los Angeles for frequent in-person collaboration
* Employee and dependent medical, dental, and vision options
* A 401(K) program with employer match
* Ample paid time off, including vacation, floating holidays, sick days, and company-paid holidays
* An Employee Assistance Program for confidential, professional support with personal, family, or other challenges

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are at Our Core**

At Ecotrak, we truly care about making life easier for the people who keep facilities running. That’s why, through our SaaS product, we’re trying to change the way repair & maintenance is done – with more automated equipment tracking, proactive insights, and warranty execution.

We’re a team that believes in building strong relationships and getting things done right with our customers—facilities leaders, service providers, and everyone dedicated to keeping operations smooth and steady.

As we say around here, we care for the people using our technology just as much as we care about making it.

If you’re ready to join a crew of hard-working, down-to-earth people trying to rapidly change an industry for the better, you’ll fit right in.

**Your Role In Keeping Things Running:**

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the steady guide for customers after go-live—driving advocacy, translating their data into decisions, and keeping accounts healthy so operations run smoothly & operators become advocates.

Build long-term relationships with customers, serving as their primary point of contact.

**What You’ll Get Done:**

Build A Strong Partnership

* Build clear success plans that tie customer goals to Ecotrak capabilities & milestones
* Host regular check-ins and business reviews with customers – to gain feedback on the success plan & provide recommendations on how to improve
* Monitor account health, flagging risks early and mobilizing the right teams (internal or external) to resolve
* Get to know customers personally – building a connection outside of just the platform

Be the Strategic Project Manager & Data Storyteller

* Build presentations that turn product usage, work orders, and asset trends into ROI narratives leaders understand
* Tailor recommendations to fit the customer's reality—industry, footprint, workflows
* Send clean executive recaps with decisions, owners, and dates that keep momentum
* Develop a deep understanding of Ecotrak’s technology to provide best practices and strategic guidance

Coordinate Cross-Functionally & Improve the Machine

* Partner with Support to close loops on issues and reduce ticket re-opens
* Work with Product to relay prioritized feedback & requirements; track outcomes back to customers
* Identify expansion signals and renewal readiness in partnership with Sales
* Coordinate closely with the Implementation, Asset Survey, & Training teams during the client onboarding process
* Identify & create operational efficiencies that raise advocacy across your book of business
* Be the voice for the client internally

**What You’ll Bring to the Crew**

In experience:

* 3–7 years in a strategic client-facing role (i.e. CSM, Management Consulting, Strategic Accounts/Partnerships, multi-location Operations Manager)
* Proven ownership of a customer book: running exec-level meetings, multi-threading stakeholders, and guiding change
* Data storytelling chops: Excel/Sheets & dashboards to turn trends into business impact
* Strong organization & project management across multiple accounts
* Crisp written & verbal communication – able to tailor presentation styles to different stakeholder groups
* Familiarity with CRM and CS tooling (Hubspot/Salesforce, Gainsight/ChurnZero); basic business intelligence a plus
* Bonus: experience in B2B technology, restaurants, convenience, retail, facilities, or field-service environments

In intangibles:

* Professional presence with a “be real” communication style—clear, kind, and direct
* Ownership mindset: you follow through, unblock others, and get sh\*t done
* Teacher’s mindset: patient, approachable, and generous with know-how
* Willingness to experiment & improve the playbook; calm under pressure/ambiguity
* Problem-solving excitement with the ability to react & adapt

**Who You’ll Work With**

In this role, the *main* people you’ll be working with are:

* Customer Success Team Lead – who you’ll report to
* Customer Experience Team (i.e. Implementation, Support, Asset Surveys) – to keep customers moving along in their journey to advocacy
* Product Team - to relay feedback and close the loop on improvements
* Sales Team - to align on renewals, upsell opportunities, and account strategy

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us**

* You’ll work with down-to-earth people, always looking to help one another.
* You’ll work at a company where your growth is in your control – no politics here!
* Your work will directly impact the success & growth of the company – you’re not just a cog in the machine.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, FSA, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
* 401(k) with 4% match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid holidays
* Company Swag & Team-building events
* Opportunities for career growth
* More listed at Ecotrak.com/careers

**Salary**: 100k - 120k

As part of our commitment to compliance with federal regulations, Ecotrak uses E-Verify to verify the employment eligibility of all employees.

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.

Arryved, part of the Fullsteam organization, is a SaaS company specializing in Point-of-Sale solutions for the craft beverage and hospitality industry. From taprooms and brewpubs to mobile ordering and online sales, Arryved helps businesses deliver seamless customer experiences for passionate craft communities.

**Job Summary:**

The **Manager, Customer Support** leads the customer support team and is accountable for team performance, service delivery, and continuous improvement of support operations. This role translates department priorities into team goals, sets expectations, coaches and develops employees, and manages staffing and coverage to deliver consistent service from initial customer contact through resolution. The Manager uses support KPIs to identify performance gaps and drive improvements in service levels, workflows, and documentation. As the escalation owner for complex customer issues, the Manager guides resolution and engages directly when needed, while partnering with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to address customer feedback and prepare the team for product changes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Provide direct people leadership for the customer support team, including setting goals and expectations, assigning work, conducting regular one-on-ones, coaching performance, and fostering an accountable, inclusive, high-performing culture.
* Manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle for the team, including participating in interviews and selection, supporting onboarding, providing ongoing coaching and development, completing performance reviews, recognizing contributions, and addressing performance concerns.
* Establish team priorities, service standards, and operating rhythms; translate department goals into clear individual and team deliverables and hold the team accountable for results.
* Manage team capacity and coverage through staffing plans, schedules, on-call rotations, and holiday coverage. Assess workload against available capacity, adjust assignments and coverage to maintain service levels, and identify staffing gaps requiring leadership decisions.
* Own team performance against support KPIs, including response time, customer satisfaction (CSAT), first-contact resolution (FCR), ticket backlog, and quality. Review trends, identify root causes of performance gaps, implement team-level improvement plans, and communicate results and progress against service expectations.
* Monitor queues and team capacity, make real-time prioritization and resource-allocation decisions, and ensure timely, effective resolution of support tickets across all levels.
* Own the escalation-management process for high-impact, complex, or at-risk customer cases. Establish clear resolution ownership, coordinate the appropriate resources, and ensure timely customer communication, follow-through, and documented resolution; engage directly when the issue requires managerial intervention.
* Serve as the team’s technical and operational escalation point, guiding employees through ambiguous issues and determining when to involve Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or senior leadership.
* Lead support-operations improvements across processes, workflows, the knowledge base, quality assurance, and training. Prioritize opportunities using service data and customer feedback, guide implementation and team adoption, and evaluate whether changes improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify customer-risk patterns and partner with Customer Success and Sales on retention strategies and coordinated action plans.
* Represent the voice of the customer by synthesizing support trends and actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Sales, and other stakeholders.
* Lead support-team readiness for new features and product changes by coordinating employee training, documentation updates, and escalation planning with cross-functional partners. Identify readiness gaps before launch and use post-launch feedback to address support issues and improve future rollouts.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including setting expectations, coaching employees, addressing performance concerns, developing talent, and creating accountability across a team.
* Sound judgment in balancing customer impact, employee capacity, service levels, and established business priorities in a fast-paced environment, including knowing when to escalate decisions or risks to senior leadership.
* Experience owning customer escalations with empathy, clarity, urgency, and disciplined follow-through.
* Demonstrated ownership of strategic support initiatives that improve efficiency, customer satisfaction, quality, and scalability.
* Ability to translate company objectives into measurable team goals, operating plans, and individual expectations.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience building or using dashboards, interpreting performance data, identifying root causes, and adjusting team priorities based on evidence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to tailor messaging for employees, customers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional influence, facilitation, conflict-resolution, and change-management skills across r

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
We are a Veteran owned organization that takes pride in servicing our active service-members and Veterans. We currently have two companies that service military personnel and Veterans in a multitude of ways, United Shield Life Insurance and United Veteran Benefits Agency.
  
  
Our mission is to provide each individual person with the support they need to transition from the military smoothly and with the education necessary to make informed decisions about their benefits. In addition, it is important to us that we ensure our Veterans receive the support they need to obtain the VA disability rating they have earned.  
  
United Veteran Benefits Agency is currently seeking a **Case Manager** to support our Veteran Benefits Specialists with current and prospective clients.  
  
This position is open to candidates located outside of Missouri and will be performed **remotely**. If you are based in Missouri, please note that this role may require in-person presence or relocation.  
  
**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Make initial contact with prospective clients and conduct intake interviews as needed.
* Track and follow up with prospective clients through the lead conversion process.
* Provide quality customer service and maintain a positive rapport with all prospects and current clients.
* Develop and maintain an effective working relationship with the Veteran Benefits Specialists (VBS).
* Assist veterans with completing any required VA forms.
* Maintain the Salesforce CRM system.

**Requirements:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Self-motivated.
* Proficient in Microsoft Suite and Adobe Acrobat.
* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience in Salesforce preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to handle daily case management.
* Ability to present realistic recommended courses of action plans designed to assist clients and develop confidence in our brand.
* Possess an understanding of military culture and terminology.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to accurately complete tasks.
* Possess the ability to move a prospective client through the initial process necessary to become a client.
