jobs.description:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run **30,000 programs**, welcomed **1.2 million applicants**, and facilitated the distribution of **more than $10 billion** in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

**About the role**

The Customer Success Manager is the primary point of contact for an assigned group of Submittable clients, building trusted advisor partnerships that connect Submittable's value to each client's business goals. The role builds tailored Success Plans, leads regular Business Reviews, and helps clients grow their programs on the platform.

The Customer Success Manager partners with Account Executives, Technical Support, and other Submittable teams to resolve client needs and identify opportunities for expansion.

**Key responsibilities**

* Build trusted advisor partnerships with assigned clients, aligning Submittable's value to each client's key and overarching business goals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, bringing in Submittable resources such as Account Executives or Technical Support as needed.
* Build long-term business relationships by following through on commitments and responding to client needs promptly.
* Evaluate client program priorities and create tailored Success Plans with clear goals and milestones, identifying barriers to program growth and recommending strategies based on client research and industry knowledge.
* Schedule and conduct Business Reviews to track Success Plan progress and identify opportunities for additional gains as they arise.
* Identify opportunities for Account Executives to expand Submittable's footprint through new features, services, and instances.
* Recommend improvements to Submittable's business, products, and client approach based on client feedback.
* Keep accurate, up-to-date client records in Salesforce.

**Skills & Competencies**

* 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, customer success, or account management.
* Experience recognizing sales and expansion opportunities within existing client accounts.
* Learns new software quickly and explains technical product functionality clearly to clients.
* Communicates clearly in writing and in conversation with client stakeholders at all levels.
* Organizes work across multiple accounts and competing priorities, meeting deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative team environment.
* Adjusts plans and approach as client needs and priorities change.
* Keeps detailed, accurate records of client activity and commitments.
* Experience using a CRM to manage client records; Salesforce experience preferred.
* Experience supporting clients through complex procurement processes, such as those at government agencies or universities, preferred.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

At Submittable, you'll find a supportive, dynamic work environment where your contributions directly influence our success. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and are excited to be part of a company dedicated to social impact, we invite you to apply!

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Dash.fi**

Dash.fi is a fast-growing fintech company offering corporate cards and adjacent financial products to SMB and enterprise businesses. We are building toward an acquisition exit and are in an aggressive growth phase — expanding verticals, scaling revenue operations, and building the infrastructure a durable business requires.

Dash.fi is building its Account Management function to create a proactive, commercially focused motion across the existing customer base. The Enterprise Account Manager will play a critical role in establishing that motion with Dash.fi's highest-value and most strategically important customers.

**The Role**

The Enterprise Account Manager owns a portfolio of Dash.fi's enterprise customers and is responsible for protecting and growing those relationships.

This is a strategic, commercially minded account management role—not a traditional customer success role. You will operate as the primary commercial owner for your accounts, developing executive relationships, understanding the customer's business and spend profile, identifying risk and expansion opportunities, and creating account strategies that drive retention and growth.

You will manage a smaller, high-value book of approximately 40–60 enterprise accounts, allowing for deeper customer engagement, executive relationships, QBRs, and complex commercial opportunities. You will work closely with the Head of AM, Sales, CS, Product, RevOps, and Commercial leadership to ensure customers have clear ownership and that opportunities and risks are acted on proactively.

**What You'll Do**

**Build the enterprise book**

* Own a portfolio of approximately 40–60 enterprise customers as their primary commercial point of contact, building executive relationships and account plans grounded in each customer's business, spend, and strategic objectives.

* Establish proactive engagement cadences so every strategic account has a clear next action.

**Protect customer retention**

* Monitor spend, engagement, and other health signals to catch early risk, then proactively address declining spend, friction, and other retention threats.

* Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders as needed and escalate material risks to the Head of AM with a clear action plan.

**Drive expansion & growth**

* Use customer conversations and account data to uncover expansion, cross-sell, and growth opportunities, executing the AM “Grow” program and managing opportunities in HubSpot.

* Partner with Product and Commercial leadership on new products, pricing, or deal structures, and build the business case to lead customers through the conversation.

**Lead the enterprise customer experience**

* Run strategic QBRs and business reviews that surface outcomes, opportunities, and risks—not just status updates.

* Gather and route customer feedback to Product, and ensure commitments are documented and followed through.

**Manage commercial interventions**

* Identify accounts needing strategic intervention on retention, pricing, or contract terms, and partner with the Head of AM and Commercial leadership on renegotiations.

* Translate commercial strategy into a clear account plan and keep complex deal cycles moving.

**Operate with discipline**

* Keep all customer activity, opportunities, and pipeline accurate in HubSpot, and use data—not just relationship strength—to prioritize engagement.

* Flag gaps in data, process, or tooling to the Head of AM.

**Partner cross-functionally**

* Work closely with Sales, CS, RevOps, Product, and Commercial leadership to keep ownership, data, and opportunities aligned.

* Clearly communicate dependencies and escalate blockers with a recommended path forward.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must-haves**

* 5-7 years of experience in account management, strategic customer success, sales, or a related commercial customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, or a similar environment.

The SMB Account Manager owns a high-volume portfolio of Dash.fi's small and mid-sized business customers and is responsible for retaining, engaging, and growing those customers through a scalable, proactive account management motion.

This is a high-velocity, data-driven commercial role. You will manage a portfolio of approximately 150–200 accounts, using established playbooks, digital-first engagement, and spend-triggered outreach to efficiently protect and grow the customer base.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, commercially curious, comfortable working with data, and energized by managing a large book of customers while continuously improving how that book is managed.

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.

**Job Overview**

QUALITY MANAGER Custom Plastic Injection Molding | Medical Manufacturing

**Location: Livermore, California**

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Quality Manager** to lead and maintain our ISO 13485 Quality Management System in a growing, fast-paced custom plastic injection molding manufacturing environment.

Reporting directly to the President, the Quality Manager will oversee quality systems, compliance, inspection and testing, customer and supplier quality, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. This individual will lead and develop a three-shift quality team while ensuring products consistently meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and established quality standards.

The ideal candidate has direct experience managing an ISO 13485-certified Quality Management System and a deep understanding of FDA requirements—and understands how to build a culture of accountability, risk-based decision-making, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Quality Management System & Regulatory Compliance**

* Lead the maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's ISO 13485 Quality Management System.
* Maintain the documented quality system, including procedures, records, document control, training, and change management.
* Oversee Management Reviews, quality objectives, performance metrics, and QMS effectiveness.
* Ensure appropriate quality-system controls are established for risk management, process validation, and production activities.
* Maintain awareness of applicable FDA requirements and other relevant regulatory and customer requirements.

**Corrective Action & Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee nonconformance reporting (NCR), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause investigations, and effectiveness verification.
* Analyze customer complaints, nonconformance trends, scrap, rework, and other quality metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate structured problem-solving and preventive action initiatives.
* Monitor corrective actions and ensure timely, effective resolution.

**Audits & Customer/Supplier Quality**

* Plan, coordinate, and host customer, registrar, and other applicable quality audits.

* Work directly with customers and suppliers to resolve quality issues and negotiate appropriate corrective actions.

**Inspection, Testing & Measurement**

* Manage inspection, testing, measurement, and product acceptance activities.
* Ensure measuring and monitoring equipment is appropriately controlled, calibrated, and maintained.
* Oversee the use of CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and other inspection equipment.
* Apply statistical process control and capability analysis, including Cpk and Gauge R&R, as appropriate.
* Support engineering changes (ECOs), controlled process deviations, and related quality records.

**Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead, coach, and develop the three-shift quality team, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and performance standards.
* Ensure employees are adequately trained and verify training effectiveness.
* Partner with Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations to resolve quality issues and improve manufacturing processes.
* Support new product introduction and the transition from development to production.
* Maintain clear accountability: Quality provides independent oversight, verification, and guidance, while Engineering, Purchasing, and Operations retain ownership of their respective processes and technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

* Minimum of **5 years of quality operations experience** in a production or manufacturing environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing an **ISO 13485 Quality Management System**, including responsibility for QMS effectiveness, audits, CAPA, nonconformances, and Management Reviews.
* Strong working knowledge of root cause analysis, risk management, corrective action, and preventive action.
* Experience managing internal and external audits and responding to customer quality requirements.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, procedures, specifications, and regulatory documentation.
* Experience with inspection and measurement tools, including CMMs, micrometers, calipers, and related equipment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Demonstrated leadership, employee training, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently while contributing effectively to a team.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, or a related field; equivalent experience will be considered.

new_jobs.title: Delivery Operations Lead (3-Month Contract)
new_jobs.description:
Growth is a system rather than a collection of marketing services, and that belief is what earned Halstead Media Group a spot on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. We're a Growth Operations partner built specifically for the landscape industry, and our work spans demand generation, CRM, sales process, reporting and the connections between them, so that landscape companies can see how opportunities are created, moved through the pipeline and turned into revenue.

As our contract Delivery Operations Lead, you'll spend the next three months making sure every piece of client work, from websites and paid media to SEO, design, copy and reporting, has an owner, a realistic timeline and a budget that holds, so our team of about 30 can keep delivering at the standard our clients expect. The process and the tools are already in place, so this is a hands-on role for someone who loves bringing order to a busy queue and wants to be routing work and making priority calls from the first week. This position is 100% remote.

*Remote - Contract, about 25 hours a week*

**What you'll do day to day**
-----------------------------

* Own the intake queue in Scoro and assign every new task to the right person within one business day, so nothing sits without an owner
* Match work to people based on capacity, skill fit, priority, dependencies and budget
* Make sure every task is ready to start, with the brief, assets and approvals in place, before it reaches the team
* Keep one prioritized delivery queue across every client and department, and be the go-to answer for who is doing what and by when
* Set and adjust timelines based on real capacity and complexity, and bring tradeoff decisions about what moves, what waits and what gets re-scoped to our VP of Client Success
* Keep a live view of workload across project management, copy, design, development, SEO and paid media, and rebalance work as priorities and availability shift
* Track budgeted versus actual hours on active projects and flag anything trending over budget while there's still time to adjust
* Map handoffs from strategy to copy to design to development to launch, and clear bottlenecks by chasing decisions and re-sequencing work
* Run a short daily dispatch and triage huddle and a weekly delivery health review that sorts work into on track, at risk and off track, with a clear next action for each
* Escalate budget overages, timeline risks and blockers early, and stay with them until they're resolved
* Keep Scoro's statuses, queues and assignments clean, and deliver a weekly report on delivery performance, completed projects with budget versus actual, and timeline status
* Keep the delivery numbers on our company scorecard accurate and on time
* Work hand in hand with our Project Managers and department leads on priorities, client commitments, staffing and quality

**How you'll know you're doing an amazing job**
-----------------------------------------------

Every part of our delivery should contribute to the same goals and be measured against them, and this role is how the whole team keeps score.

* Every new task has an owner within one business day
* More of our work is delivered within its budgeted hours
* On-time delivery climbs, and launch dates hold
* Risks surface early, well before they touch a deadline or a client

**Company Overview**

Insignia Federal Group is a woman-owned small business providing personalized consulting services to private and public sector clients. Its expertise includes professional IT services, program management, training, and acquisition support.

**Job Summary**

Insignia Federal Group is a professional consulting firm headquartered in McLean, Virginia. We have an excellent opportunity for a **Quality Assurance Analyst** to support a federal government client. This role involves ensuring the quality, accessibility, and usability of large-scale federal websites and web applications through manual and automated testing within an Agile delivery environment. The Quality Assurance Analyst should be detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable engaging early in the development cycle, reviewing requirements, building test cases before development is complete, and validating finished work against acceptance criteria. The successful candidate will work closely with business analysts, developers, UI/UX designers, and federal stakeholders to deliver reliable, standards-compliant digital experiences.

**Successful Candidate:**

**Test Planning & Requirements Analysis**

* 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance for web-based applications.
* Independently review user stories, acceptance criteria, functional requirements, and UI/UX designs to identify test scenarios, missing requirements, dependencies, and potential risks.
* Develop and maintain organized test plans, suites, and test cases grouped by application functionality, features, and components, with traceability to Jira tickets and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare test cases proactively during backlog refinement and development, rather than waiting until features are ready for QA.
* Design positive, negative, and exploratory test scenarios to validate both documented requirements and unexpected application behavior.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts and developers to clarify ambiguities and ensure requirements are sufficiently testable before implementation is complete.

**Manual & Automated Testing**

* Perform hands-on functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of web applications and interactive website functionality.
* Prioritize testing and retesting of active sprint deliverables to support code-freeze and release commitments.
* Designing and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks is a plus.
* Perform targeted regression testing after bug fixes to identify unintended impacts on related functionality.
* Validate functionality across browsers, devices, screen sizes, and user interaction scenarios.

**Accessibility & Usability Testing**

* Strong working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA requirements.
* Experience conducting accessibility testing using web tools (e.g., ANDI or JAWS) and manual methods.
* Experience identifying usability issues and communicating them clearly to design and development teams.

**Content Management Systems**

* Experience testing websites built on Drupal or other enterprise content management systems.
* Familiarity with CMS workflows, content types, and publishing processes.
* Experience validating interactive web application functionality, including user inputs, form validation, search/filter behavior, conditional workflows, data-driven results, and third-party integrations.

**Defect Management**

* Independently investigate and document defects with clear steps and relevant details.
* Create, track, and maintain defects in Jira, linking findings to the appropriate user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases.
* Work directly with developers to resolve issues, validate corrections, and perform regression testing before closing defects.
* Proactively communicate critical defects, testing blockers, coverage gaps, and release risks to the development and delivery teams.

**Agile Delivery & Collaboration**

* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.
* Proficient with Jira and Confluence for defect tracking, test management, and documentation.
* Ability to write clear, reproducible defect reports and work collaboratively with developers through resolution.
* Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and communicating test results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or four or more years of equivalent professional experience in software quality assurance. Must be detail-oriented with strong analytical, written communication, and organizational skills. Ability to manage multiple testing priorities in a fast-paced federal delivery environment. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Experience supporting federal government websites or digital modernization programs
* DHS Section 508 Trusted Tester certification
* ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification
* Familiarity with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS)
* Experience with visual regression testing tools
* Exposure to API testing tools such as Postman

* Partner with telecom on caller ID and attestation to protect contact rate.
* Genesys administrators carry out configuration changes; this role decides them.

**Daily allocation and channel monitoring**

* Review prior-day performance by source: contact rate, acceptance rate, LCPH, scheduled and completed visits.
* Make same-day list and hours adjustments within the decision rights below.
* Watch disposition trends for signs that a model input has drifted.
* Track text, IVR and print response as inputs to voice hours, and as scope expands, recommend channel-mix shifts.

* Produce a monthly capacity outlook and channel performance summary with explicit recommendations.
